name: Dytor 20mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About DYTOR 20MG TABLET

DYTOR 20MG TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking DYTOR 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of DYTOR 20MG TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking DYTOR 20MG TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.
uses: Oedema associated with congestive heart failure, kidney, or liver disease
Essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How DYTOR 20MG TABLET Works

DYTOR 20MG TABLET inhibits reabsorption of sodium and chloride in kidney by increasing urinary excretion of sodium, chloride, and water.  Thus, removing excessive fluid from the body.
usageInstructions: Take DYTOR 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water.
Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
Do not stop taking DYTOR 20MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Side Effects Of DYTOR 20MG TABLET

Like all medicines, DYTOR 20MG TABLET may cause side effects in few individuals, although not everybody gets them

Common Side Effects of DYTOR 20MG TABLET:
Muscle cramps
Excessive alkaline in the body
Headache, Dizziness
Tiredness, weakness
Disturbances in the amount of body water and minerals
Increased blood concentrations of uric acid, sugar and fats
Reduced potassium and sodium levels in blood
Reduced blood volume
Loss of appetite
Stomach pain
Nausea, vomiting
Diarrhea
Constipation
Increase of certain liver enzyme levels (gamma-GT)
Creeping sensation or tingling in arms and legs

Stop taking DYTOR 20MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Tinnitus (ringing in ears), hearing loss
Electrolyte and volume depletion (headache, dizziness, low blood pressure, weakness, drowsiness, confusion, loss of appetite, cramps)
Low blood pressure
Worsening of kidney function

warnings.details: Safety and effectiveness of DYTOR 20MG TABLET in pregnant women or women planning to get pregnant has not been established yet. Hence it should be used during pregnancy only if clearly needed.

Safety and effectiveness of DYTOR 20MG TABLET in breastfeeding women has not been established yet as it is not known if the medicine is excreted in the breastmilk. Hence it should be used with caution when administered to a nursing woman.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after taking DYTOR 20MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DYTOR 20MG TABLET because it might make you feel dizzy or drowsy.

DYTOR 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in anuric patients (kidneys fail to produce urine). DYTOR 20MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with kidney failure, and severe urinary flow disorders. The dose will be adjusted by your doctor.
DYTOR 20MG TABLET is not recommended for patients with hepatic coma or pre-coma. DYTOR 20MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver diseases like cirrhosis and ascites.
Do not take DYTOR 20MG TABLET if you are allergic to Torsemide or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
DYTOR 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart failure.
DYTOR 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children as safety data has not been established yet.
There is no information on dosage adjustments in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking DYTOR 20MG TABLET.

Others

DYTOR 20MG TABLET is not recommended if you have:

Low volume of blood (hypovolaemia)
Low blood pressure (hypotension)

Before taking DYTOR 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage heart conditions like increased blood pressure and heart insufficiency (Ex. captopril, enalapril, digoxin, digitoxin, methyldigoxin)

Medicines used to manage high blood sugar (Ex. chlorpropamide, glibenclamide, glipizide, tolbutamide)

Medicines used to manage constipation (Ex. methylcellulose, psyllium)

Medicines used to manage inflammation and certain skin conditions (Ex. hydrocortisone, prednisone, dexamethasone)
Medicines used to manage low blood pressure (Ex. adrenaline, noradrenaline)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of DYTOR 20MG TABLET, contact your doctor immediately. Symptoms of DYTOR 20MG TABLET overdose include excessive urine, sleepiness, confusion, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, circulatory collapse or upset stomach.

name: Lasix 40mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About LASIX 40MG TABLET

Lasix 40mg Tablet is a loop diuretic commonly used to help the body remove excess water and salt through urine. It is often recommended for individuals experiencing fluid retention (edema) due to conditions affecting the heart, liver, or kidneys. By supporting fluid balance, Lasix 40mg can help reduce swelling in the legs, ankles and lungs, improving overall comfort and mobility in daily life.

This tablet is ideal for patients who require assistance in managing fluid overload and related swelling under the guidance of a healthcare professional. It is generally taken once or twice a day, preferably in the morning to avoid nighttime urination. Lasix 40mg Tablet can be taken with water on an empty stomach or a light meal, and hydration should be maintained as recommended by your doctor. Monitoring blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolytes regularly is important during its use.  

Lasix 40mg Tablet may cause dizziness, dehydration or electrolyte imbalance, especially if fluid intake is not managed properly. Alcohol, excessive caffeine, and high-salt foods should be limited. People with kidney, liver or blood pressure concerns should use this medicine only under medical supervision. Regular monitoring of weight and fluid balance is advised to ensure safe and effective results. 

Lasix 40mg Tablet should only be used during pregnancy if clearly advised by a doctor. It may pass into breast milk and reduce milk supply, so medical guidance is essential for breastfeeding mothers. Common side effects include increased urination, dizziness, dehydration, and occasional leg cramps, which usually improve with proper hydration and diet adjustments. Seek medical attention if severe weakness, irregular heartbeat, or persistent dizziness occurs.

mechanismOfAction:
How LASIX 40MG TABLET Works
Lasix Mechanism of Action

Lasix 40mg is a loop diuretic that works by acting on a specific part of the kidney called the loop of Henle. It blocks the reabsorption of sodium, chloride, and water, which increases urine production. By removing excess fluid and salts, it helps in maintaining healthy fluid balance and reducing swelling in the body.

How Lasix 40mg Works in the Kidney

Lasix 40mg acts mainly in the kidneys, targeting the ascending loop of Henle. It prevents the kidneys from absorbing too much salt, which forces extra water and electrolytes to leave the body through urine. This action reduces fluid buildup, supports better circulation, and eases pressure on the heart and blood vessels.
usageInstructions: Take Lasix 40mg by mouth with water, usually in the morning.
Swallow the tablet whole; do not crush or chew unless advised.
It can be taken on an empty stomach or with a light meal for better absorption.
Avoid taking it late in the evening to reduce nighttime urination.
Follow the exact dosage schedule recommended by your doctor.
If you miss a dose, take it when you remember unless it’s near the next dose.
Do not double the dose to make up for a missed one.
Drink enough water as advised to prevent dehydration.
Regularly monitor your weight, blood pressure, and electrolytes while on Lasix.
Always consult your doctor before changing your dose or stopping the medicine.

name: Dytor 10mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About DYTOR 10MG TABLET

Dytor 10 Tablet contains torsemide, a diuretic medication used to reduce excess fluid retention in the body (edema) caused by heart, liver, or kidney conditions. It is also effective in managing high blood pressure.

It works by removing excess salts and fluids from the body (especially from the kidneys, lungs, heart, stomach) in the form of urine which helps reduce swelling caused by excess fluid buildup in conditions like heart failure, liver cirrhosis, or kidney disorders.

Dytor 10 Tablet is usually taken once a day with or without food. Try to take this medicine at the same time each day to help you remember. Take this medicine exactly as suggested by your doctor. Do not take more tablets in one day without consulting your doctor.

The active ingredient Torsemide present in the medicine controls high blood pressure and edema but does not cure these conditions. Therefore, continue to take this medicine even if you feel well. Do not stop taking Dytor 10 Tablet without talking to your doctor.

Common Side Effects of Dytor 10 Tablet are dizziness or lightheadedness, increased urination, low potassium levels, nausea or upset stomach or electrolyte imbalance. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

Before taking Dytor 10 tablet, inform your doctor about all your pre-existing disease conditions and medicines you currently take. Dytor 10 is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women.

Dytor 10 Tablet for Edema (Water Retention):

As a diuretic medication, Dytor helps reduce fluid buildup in the body, improving symptoms like swelling in the legs, ankles, and abdomen. It works by increasing the kidneys' ability to eliminate excess salt and water.

Dytor 10 Tablet for High Blood Pressure:

By promoting the elimination of excess fluid and salt, Dytor tablet helps reduce the overall blood volume, which lowers the pressure within the blood vessels. For patients with high blood pressure, using Dytor in combination with lifestyle changes and other prescribed medications can support effective blood pressure management.

Usage of Dytor in Heart Failure Patients:

It works by removing excess fluid from the body, alleviating symptoms like shortness of breath, swelling, and fatigue. As a diuretic, Dytor 10 helps prevent fluid buildup in the lungs and other organs, thereby improving overall heart function and patient comfort.

Dytor 10 Tablet Uses in Kidney Disease:

For patients with kidney disease, Dytor 10 Tablet plays a crucial role in managing fluid retention and reducing swelling. Kidney dysfunction often leads to the inability to effectively remove excess salt and water, causing edema. By increasing urination, Dytor helps kidneys excrete excess fluid and reduce swelling.

Dytor 10 Tablet for Liver Cirrhosis:

In patients with liver cirrhosis, Dytor 10 Tablet is often prescribed to help manage fluid retention and ascites, a common complication of liver disease. The diuretic action of Dytor 10 helps reduce abdominal swelling and prevents the buildup of fluid in the abdominal cavity.
mechanismOfAction:
How DYTOR 10MG TABLET Works

Dytor 10 Tablet contains an active ingredient called torsemide which is a diuretic agent (water pill). It works by eliminating excess salt and fluid accumulated in the body (due to kidney, liver and heart problems) via urine.

This helps relieve conditions like edema, high blood pressure, and fluid retention due to heart, liver, or kidney diseases. By removing extra fluid, Dytor helps lower the pressure in the blood vessels and organs, improving overall health and comfort.
usageInstructions: Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water, preferably in the morning to avoid frequent urination at night.
It can be taken with or without food
The dosage of Dytor 10mg depends on your medical condition, age, and response to the treatment.
For adults, the starting dose typically ranges from 5 to 10 mg daily. Your doctor may adjust the dose based on your progress.
Do not self-adjust the dose without consulting your healthcare provider. Regular monitoring of electrolyte levels and kidney function may be required during the treatment.
For managing edema (fluid retention), the usual dose of Dytor 10mg Tablet is 10-20 mg once daily.
In severe cases, the dosage may be increased as per your doctor’s recommendation. Ensure adequate hydration and follow a low-sodium diet for best results.
In patients with kidney disease, the dosage of Dytor 10mg varies based on the severity of the condition.
Typically, the doctor may start with a lower dose, such as 5-10 mg daily, to minimize the risk of side effects.
For advanced kidney conditions, higher doses may be prescribed under close medical supervision to prevent dehydration and electrolyte imbalances.
If you miss a dose of Dytor 10 Tablet, take it as soon as you remember.
However, if it’s almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule.

Do not take two doses at the same time to make up for the missed one, as it may increase the risk of side effects like dehydration or low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if you frequently miss doses.
The maximum dosage of Dytor 10mg Tablet varies based on the condition being treated and the patient’s tolerance.
For most conditions, the dose should not exceed 20-40 mg daily, depending on the severity of fluid retention.

What Happens if I Miss a Dose of Dytor 10?
If you miss a dose of Dytor 10 Tablet, take it as soon as you remember.
However, if it’s almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule.
Do not take two doses at the same time to make up for the missed one, as it may increase the risk of side effects like dehydration or low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if you frequently miss doses.
Can I Adjust the Dosage of Dytor 10?

No, you should not adjust the dosage of Dytor 10 Tablet on your own. Changing the dose without consulting your doctor can lead to serious side effects, including dehydration, low potassium levels, or electrolyte imbalances. If you feel the current dose isn’t effective or causes unwanted effects, discuss it with your doctor for proper evaluation and adjustment.

What is the Maximum Dosage of Dytor 10mg Tablet?
The maximum dosage of Dytor 10mg Tablet varies based on the condition being treated and the patient’s tolerance.
For most conditions, the dose should not exceed 20-40 mg daily, depending on the severity of fluid retention.

Your doctor will determine the safe maximum dose for your specific situation. Taking doses higher than prescribed can lead to severe side effects and complications.

Dietary Tips for Reducing Fluid Retention:
Limit foods high in sodium, such as processed foods, fast food, and canned soups, as salt encourages water retention. Opt for low-sodium alternatives and season with herbs instead of salt.
Drink plenty of water throughout the day to maintain proper fluid balance and flush out excess sodium.
Include bananas, avocados, spinach, sweet potatoes, and coconut water, as potassium helps balance sodium levels and reduce swelling.
Consume foods like cucumber, watermelon, pineapple, celery, and asparagus, which have natural diuretic properties.
Reduce intake of white bread, pastries, and sugary snacks, which can contribute to water retention.
Exercise Tips for Managing Swelling and Edema:
Low-impact exercises like walking, yoga, or swimming can improve circulation and help reduce swelling.
Rest with your legs elevated for 20–30 minutes daily to reduce fluid buildup in the lower limbs.
Avoid sitting or standing in one position for long periods. Gentle stretching or ankle rotations can promote blood flow.
Activities like aqua aerobics or water walking can help reduce swelling while being gentle on joints.

Introduction About ALDACTONE 25MG TABLET
What is Aldactone 25mg Tablet used for?

Aldactone 25mg Tablet is commonly chosen by individuals who are managing fluid levels in the body. It contains Spironolactone, a potassium-sparing component that works by supporting healthy salt and water balance. It may be part of a broader wellness plan involving regular check-ups, dietary adjustments, or lifestyle management.

Aldactone 25mg Tablet is typically taken once daily or as directed by your healthcare provider. Taking it after meals may help reduce the chance of stomach discomfort. Always follow your healthcare professional advice for best results.

Avoid combining with high-potassium foods or supplements unless recommended. Check with your doctor if you are already on other medications, especially diuretics or blood pressure-related tablets. Ideal hydration practices are encouraged during the course of usage.

Use Aldactone 25mg Tablet during pregnancy or breastfeeding should only be considered if clearly advised by a healthcare provider, as spironolactone may influence hormone levels. Always inform your doctor about any other medications, especially other diuretics, NSAIDs, or hormone-affecting therapies, to avoid interactions.

It is important to avoid excessive potassium-rich foods or supplements, and space it away (by 2 hours) from iron or calcium tablets for best absorption. Regular monitoring of blood potassium and kidney function is advised while using Aldactone.

The common side effects may include increased urination, mild dizziness, breast discomfort, or menstrual changes in some individuals. These effects may vary by gender and dosage.

mechanismOfAction:
How ALDACTONE 25MG TABLET Works
What does Aldactone 25mg do in the body?
Aldactone 25mg Tablet contains Spironolactone, a potassium-sparing diuretic that helps the body remove excess water and sodium while retaining potassium. It works by blocking the action of a hormone called aldosterone, which is responsible for signaling the kidneys to retain salt and water. By reducing the effect of aldosterone, Aldactone helps the kidneys naturally excrete excess fluid, easing symptoms of fluid buildup such as swelling in the legs, abdomen, or lungs
In addition to its role in supporting fluid balance, Aldactone also has mild effects on androgen (male hormone) activity, making it suitable for certain hormone-sensitive conditions under a healthcare provider’s guidance. It is often considered in people who need fluid control without the potassium loss associated with some other water pills
Key actions of Aldactone 25mg:
Helps reduce water retention (edema)
Supports blood pressure regulation in specific individuals
Maintains potassium balance
Assists in managing androgen-related concerns under expert advice
Is Aldactone a water pill or hormone pill?
Aldactone 25mg Tablet is primarily considered a potassium-sparing diuretic, commonly referred to as a “water pill”
However, Aldactone also has mild anti-androgenic properties, meaning it can influence certain hormonal pathways, particularly those involving androgens (male hormones)
Is Aldactone used for fluid retention or hormonal imbalance?
For fluid retention: Commonly used to manage swelling, bloating, or excess water buildup
For hormonal imbalance: Occasionally advised in specific cases like androgen-related concerns

warnings.details: Aldactone 25mg Tablet is generally not advised during pregnancy.

Spironolactone and its metabolites may pass into breast milk in small amounts. While data is limited, caution is advised when Aldactone 25mg Tablet is considered for breastfeeding mothers. Your doctor will help determine if it is suitable for use during this period or if alternative options should be explored.

Aldactone 25mg Tablet may cause drowsiness, dizziness, or light-headedness in some individuals, especially during the early days of use or after a dose adjustment. These effects can affect your ability to drive safely or operate machinery.

It is advisable to limit or avoid alcohol consumption while using Aldactone 25mg Tablet. Alcohol can intensify side effects such as dizziness, low blood pressure, or light-headedness, especially when standing up or during physical activity. This is because both Aldactone and alcohol may have a relaxing effect on blood vessels, which could make you feel faint or unsteady.

Aldactone 25mg Tablet is generally not advised for individuals with severely reduced kidney function or sudden worsening of kidney health, especially in cases where little to no urine is being produced. It should be used with caution in those with underlying kidney concerns such as advanced renal dysfunction.
Aldactone 25mg Tablet should be used carefully in individuals with serious liver conditions, and only under medical supervision.
Do not take Aldactone 25mg Tablet if you are allergic to Spironolactone or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Aldactone 25mg Tablet is generally not recommended for children with moderate to severe kidney conditions. It should be used cautiously in children with high blood pressure and only under the supervision of a pediatric specialist. Always consult your child’s doctor before administering this medicine.
Aldactone 25mg Tablet should be used carefully in elderly patients, particularly if there are existing kidney concerns.

Introduction About DYTOR 5MG TABLET
What is Dytor 5mg used for?

Dytor 5mg Tablet is a diuretic medicine (water pill) used to reduce excess fluid levels in the body caused by conditions like heart failure, liver disease, or kidney disorders. It helps relieve symptoms such as swelling (edema) and shortness of breath.

Dytor 5mg Tablet reduces swelling and water retention, improves breathing in heart failure patients and also controls high blood pressure (in some cases).

Take Dytor 5mg Tablet as directed by your physician. It is usually taken once a day with or without food. Avoid taking it late in the day to manage frequent urination at night.

Before taking Dytor 5mg Tablet, consult your doctor if you have kidney or liver problems. Dytor tablet is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless prescribed. Always monitor electrolyte levels regularly while using this medication.

The most common side effects of taking Dytor 5mg Tablet are dehydration, dizziness, low potassium levels or increased urination. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects persist or worsen.

DYTOR PLUS LS TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking DYTOR PLUS LS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DYTOR PLUS LS TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking DYTOR PLUS LS TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. DYTOR PLUS LS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

DYTOR PLUS LS TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How DYTOR PLUS LS TABLET Works

DYTOR PLUS LS TABLET contains two medicines namely spironolactone and torsemide. Both spironolactone and torsemide acts by removing the excess water and electrolytes (sodium and chloride) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing blood pressure. Additionally, spironolactone can manage the loss of potassium via urine and can block the release of certain chemicals in the kidneys (aldosterone) that causes endocrine problems.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking DYTOR PLUS LS TABLET unless your doctor tells you to stop.

Others

Have high levels of potassium in your blood (hyperkalaemia)
Have Addison’s disease (deficiency of cortisol and aldosterone)

There is no proper information regarding the use of DYTOR PLUS LS TABLET in children and adolescents (below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

DYTOR PLUS LS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

low blood pressure, decreased body fluids and electrolytes levels, low blood sodium levels, abnormal blood potassium levels, increased RBC count, drowsiness, mental confusion, erythematous rash, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, diarrhoea, or liver problems.

introduction:
Introduction About TIDE 5MG TABLET

TIDE 5MG TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking TIDE 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of TIDE 5MG TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking TIDE 5MG TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.

introduction:
Introduction About AQUAZIDE 12.5MG TABLET

AQUAZIDE 12.5MG TABLET contains Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is as an adjuvant therapy in managing edema (fluid accumulation) that is caused due to heart failure, liver inflammation (Ex. liver cirrhosis), kidney problems or due to intake of steroid medications. It can also be used in the management of hypertension (high blood pressure) either alone or in combination with other medications.

During management with AQUAZIDE 12.5MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking AQUAZIDE 12.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, diabetes, low blood potassium levels, gout or electrolyte imbalance as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking AQUAZIDE 12.5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking AQUAZIDE 12.5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, constipation, muscle spasm, blurred vision and impotence. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About LASILACTONE 50MG TABLET

LASILACTONE 50MG TABLET is a combination medication containing spironolactone (a potassium-sparing diuretic) and furosemide (a loop diuretic). It is commonly prescribed by healthcare professionals to help manage fluid retention while maintaining appropriate potassium levels. This formulation works by promoting the removal of excess fluid from the body without causing significant potassium loss.

It is recommended to take LASILACTONE 50MG TABLET in the morning with food to help reduce frequent urination during the night. For optimal results, try to take it at the same time each day. The dosage and frequency will depend on the condition being managed, as determined by your doctor. Continue taking the medication for the full duration prescribed by your doctor.

Common side effect of this medication includes dehydration, dryness of mouth, thirst, weakness, lethargy, muscle pains, low blood pressure, dizziness, headache, nausea or vomiting, gynecomastia (in males), increased urination and electrolyte imbalance. Therefore, it is important to regularly monitor kidney function and electrolyte levels while taking this medication.

Before taking LASILACTONE 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are severely dehydrated or have diabetes, gout, prostate problems, or low blood pressure which makes you feel dizzy while standing up or changing position. It is not recommended for use in patients with severe low sodium levels in their blood. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.
uses: Edema (fluid retention)
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How LASILACTONE 50MG TABLET Works

LASILACTONE 50MG TABLET works by combining two diuretics such as spironolactone and furosemide to effectively remove excess fluid from the body while maintaining electrolyte balance. Furosemide acts on the loop of Henle in the kidneys to increase the excretion of sodium, chloride, and water, leading to rapid diuresis and relief from fluid overload. Meanwhile, spironolactone blocks the action of aldosterone, reducing sodium retention and preventing the loss of potassium. Together, they promote fluid removal in conditions like heart failure, liver cirrhosis, or kidney disease while minimizing the risk of potassium deficiency.

introduction:
Introduction About TORVIGRESS 40MG TABLET

TORVIGRESS 40MG TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking TORVIGRESS 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of TORVIGRESS 40MG TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking TORVIGRESS 40MG TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.

name: CTD 6.25mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About CTD 6.25MG TABLET

CTD 6.25mg Tablet is a diuretic (water pill) containing chlorthalidone. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and edema (fluid retention) caused by conditions such as heart failure, liver disease, kidney disease and lung disease that works by increasing urine production, which helps eliminate excess water and salt from the body, thereby lowering blood pressure and reducing swelling.

CTD 6.25 Tablet helps your body get rid of excess water by increasing urine production and may be prescribed alone or with other medications. It should be taken during the day to reduce frequent urination at night. Always follow your doctor’s instructions regarding dose and duration, and do not stop the medication suddenly without consulting your doctor, as this could cause your blood pressure to rise again and increase your risk of heart disease and stroke. Most people with high blood pressure do not feel unwell, so regular use and monitoring are important to reduce complications.

Regular blood pressure monitoring is essential while taking this medication, as it forms just one part of an overall management plan. Alongside CTD 6.25 Tablet, managing high blood pressure should also include maintaining a healthy diet, engaging in regular physical activity, quitting smoking, limiting alcohol consumption, and achieving a healthy weight. You can continue your usual diet while on this medicine, but it is advisable to limit your salt intake.

Common side effects of CTD 6.25 Tablet include headache, dizziness, nausea, weakness, frequent urination, dry mouth, low blood pressure, and low potassium or electrolyte imbalance. If these effects are troublesome, consult your doctor. Before starting this medication, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver problems. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should seek medical advice before taking this medicine. Also, let your doctor know about all other medications you are taking before starting CTD 6.25 Tablet.

Edema (fluid retention)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CTD 6.25MG TABLET
Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Edema (fluid retention)
mechanismOfAction:
How CTD 6.25MG TABLET Works

CTD 6.25mg Tablet contains chlorthalidone, a thiazide-like diuretic, which works primarily by increasing the excretion of sodium and water from the body through the kidneys.

Mechanism of Action of CTD 6.25mg Tablet

Chlorthalidone inhibits the Na?/Cl? symporter in the distal convoluted tubule of the kidney, reducing the reabsorption of sodium and chloride. This action leads to increased elimination of sodium, chloride, and water in urine, thereby decreasing the overall fluid volume in the body.

Role of Chlorthalidone in CTD 6.25mg Tablet

Chlorthalidone is the active ingredient in CTD 6.25mg Tablet. Its primary role is to treat high blood pressure and edema by promoting diuresis (increased urine production) and reducing fluid overload.

Understanding the Diuretic Effect

The diuretic effect of chlorthalidone means it helps the body remove excess water and salt, which lowers blood pressure and reduces swelling. This effect is particularly useful in managing conditions like hypertension, heart failure, and fluid retention due to kidney or liver disorders.

CTD 6.25mg Tablet and Electrolyte Balance

By increasing sodium excretion, chlorthalidone also causes the body to lose potassium and, to a lesser extent, magnesium and chloride, potentially leading to electrolyte imbalances such as low potassium (hypokalemia) and low sodium (hyponatremia). Regular monitoring of electrolyte levels is recommended during management.

Impact on Blood Pressure and Fluid Levels

Initially, CTD 6.25mg Tablet lowers blood pressure by reducing plasma and extracellular fluid volume, which decreases cardiac output. Over time, the main effect is a sustained reduction in peripheral vascular resistance, helping to maintain lower blood pressure even after fluid levels stabilize. By reducing fluid overload, it also eases symptoms of edema and supports cardiovascular health.
usageDetails:
How to use CTD 6.25MG TABLET

Follow your doctor's instructions regarding the exact dosage. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage.

Recommended Dosage:

The typical starting dose for hypertension is 12.5 mg to 25 mg once daily, adjusted based on your doctor’s advice and your response to management. For edema, the dose may range from 25 mg to 50 mg daily.

Administration Guidelines:
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it. Take it at the same time each day for best results. CTD 6.25mg can be taken with or without food, but consistency is important.

Best Time to Take CTD 6.25mg Tablet:

Take the tablet during the daytime, preferably in the morning, to avoid frequent urination at night. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime.

Longer duration of action than hydrochlorothiazide, providing more consistent blood pressure control over 24 hours.

introduction:
Introduction About DYTOR E 10 COMBI KIT

DYTOR E 10 COMBI KIT is a combination of Eplerenone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used in adults to manage high blood pressure and edema (swelling due to fluid retention) related to heart failure.

Hypertension is defined as persistently increased blood pressure, that can show symptoms like headache, sweating, fast heartbeat or throbbing sensation. Fluid regularly drains into body tissues from the blood. When this fluid isn’t removed from the tissue, fluid retention (edema) occurs, causing symptoms like swelling and aching of affected body parts such as feet, ankles or hands.

During course of the management your doctor might regularly monitor your kidney or liver function test to avoid any untoward side effects.

Before taking DYTOR E 10 COMBI KIT, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, heart or liver problems, high or low blood potassium levels, diabetes, low blood volume or difficulty in passing urine.

DYTOR E 10 COMBI KIT is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents due to lack of safety and effectiveness.

The most common side effects of taking DYTOR E 10 COMBI KIT are muscle cramps, diarrhoea, nausea, dizziness, headache and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

Uses Of DYTOR E 10 COMBI KIT
Manage high blood pressure and edema related to heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How DYTOR E 10 COMBI KIT Works

DYTOR E 10 COMBI KIT lowers edema where eplerenone blocks aldosterone, which is a mineralocorticoid acting on epithelial (e.g., kidney) and nonepithelial (e.g., heart and blood vessels) receptors to cause sodium and water reabsorption, and torsemide induces excretion of sodium, chloride and water by inhibiting sodium and chloride reabsorption in kidney tubules.
usageDetails:

Take DYTOR E 10 COMBI KIT as advised by your physician. Swallow DYTOR E 10 COMBI KIT with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking DYTOR E 10 COMBI KIT unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About AMIFRU 5/40MG TABLET

AMIFRU 5/40MG TABLET is a combination of Amiloride and Furosemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used in the management of extra build-up of water in the body. Symptoms include swollen ankles, feeling more tired than usual and shortness of breath. 

AMIFRU 5/40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney and liver problems, low blood volume or dehydration problem, not passing any urine, addison’s disease (which makes you feel weak and tired).

AMIFRU 5/40MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with diabetes, low blood pressure, prostate problems, gout, systemic lupus erythematosus and if you are scheduled for a glucose test.

AMIFRU 5/40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Also, it is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) particularly those with dementia or other conditions which may increase the risk of low blood pressure.

The most common side effects of taking AMIFRU 5/40MG TABLET are diarrhoea, constipation, loss of appetite, stomach pain, weakness and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage extra build-up of water in the body
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMIFRU 5/40MG TABLET
Manage extra build-up of water in the body
mechanismOfAction:
How AMIFRU 5/40MG TABLET Works

AMIFRU 5/40MG TABLET effectively stops extra build-up of water in the body by acting on different parts of the kidney and promoting water excretion. It inhibits certain system (sodium-potassium-chloride cotransporters) which results in increased excretion of water with some salts. AMIFRU 5/40MG TABLET also has a potassium-sparring effect and reduces the amount of potassium excretion from the body.

Take AMIFRU 5/40MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Fruselac Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About FRUSELAC TABLET

FRUSELAC TABLET is a combination medication containing spironolactone (a potassium-sparing diuretic) and furosemide (a loop diuretic). It is commonly prescribed by healthcare professionals to help manage fluid retention while maintaining appropriate potassium levels. This formulation works by promoting the removal of excess fluid from the body without causing significant potassium loss.

It is recommended to take FRUSELAC TABLET in the morning with food to help reduce frequent urination during the night. For optimal results, try to take it at the same time each day. The dosage and frequency will depend on the condition being managed, as determined by your doctor. Continue taking the medication for the full duration prescribed by your doctor.

Common side effect of this medication includes dehydration, dryness of mouth, thirst, weakness, lethargy, muscle pains, low blood pressure, dizziness, headache, nausea or vomiting, gynecomastia (in males), increased urination and electrolyte imbalance. Therefore, it is important to regularly monitor kidney function and electrolyte levels while taking this medication.

Before taking FRUSELAC TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are severely dehydrated or have diabetes, gout, prostate problems, or low blood pressure which makes you feel dizzy while standing up or changing position. It is not recommended for use in patients with severe low sodium levels in their blood. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.
uses: Edema (fluid retention)
usesDetails:
Uses Of FRUSELAC TABLET
Edema (fluid retention)
mechanismOfAction:
How FRUSELAC TABLET Works

FRUSELAC TABLET works by combining two diuretics such as spironolactone and furosemide to effectively remove excess fluid from the body while maintaining electrolyte balance. Furosemide acts on the loop of Henle in the kidneys to increase the excretion of sodium, chloride, and water, leading to rapid diuresis and relief from fluid overload. Meanwhile, spironolactone blocks the action of aldosterone, reducing sodium retention and preventing the loss of potassium. Together, they promote fluid removal in conditions like heart failure, liver cirrhosis, or kidney disease while minimizing the risk of potassium deficiency.

usageDetails:
How to use FRUSELAC TABLET

Follow your doctor's instructions regarding the exact dosage. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not stop the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel better.

How to Take FRUSELAC TABLET ?

Dosage: Take exactly as prescribed by your doctor, usually once daily, preferably in the morning to avoid nighttime urination.

With or without food: It can be taken with food to reduce stomach upset.

Swallow whole: Do not crush or chew the tablet.

Stay hydrated: Drink adequate water unless otherwise advised by your doctor.

Avoid high-potassium foods (like bananas, oranges) unless directed, as spironolactone can increase potassium levels.

Regular monitoring: Your doctor may ask for periodic blood tests to monitor electrolytes and kidney function.

Practical Tips for Users:
Setting Reminders: Consider using a daily alarm or reminder on your phone to ensure you take your medication at the same time every day.
Track Your Doses: Keeping a simple medication log can help you track when you have taken the medication, making it easier to avoid missed doses.
Avoid Overdosing: Do not exceed the recommended dosage. If you accidentally take more than prescribed, contact your doctor immediately.

Severe dehydration or electrolyte imbalance symptoms such as dizziness or fainting, confusion or mental changes, extreme thirst or dry mouth, muscle cramps or weakness

More Information
1.Product Comparison

a) FRUSELAC TABLET  Vs Lasix

Feature

	FRUSELAC TABLET	

Lasix (Furosemide)




Active Ingredients

	

Spironolactone (50 mg) + Furosemide (20 mg)

	

Furosemide (usually 40 mg per tablet)




Drug Class

	

Combination: Potassium-sparing + Loop diuretic

	

Loop diuretic




Primary Action

	

Dual-action: prevents fluid retention & potassium loss

	

Strong diuretic effect, promotes fluid loss




Potassium Balance

	

Helps maintain potassium levels (due to spironolactone)

	

Risk of potassium loss (hypokalemia)




Common Use

	

Edema, congestive heart failure, liver cirrhosis, ascites

	

Edema, hypertension, heart failure




Dosing Convenience

	

Combination pill (2-in-1) for better compliance

	

Single drug; may need K+ supplements separately




Prescribing Preference

	

Preferred in liver disease, ascites, or long-term edema management

	

Preferred for rapid fluid loss, short-term use




Electrolyte Risk

	

Lower risk of hypokalemia

	

Higher risk of hypokalemia

Why FRUSELAC TABLET Stands Out:

Potassium-Sparing Advantage:
FRUSELAC TABLET  includes spironolactone, which conserves potassium—minimizing the risk of hypokalemia, a major side effect of Lasix alone.
Comprehensive Diuresis:
Combines the powerful fluid-removal effect of furosemide with the aldosterone-blocking effects of spironolactone, offering broader management especially for cirrhosis-related ascites or heart failure.
Better Compliance:
Two medications in a single tablet = fewer pills and better patient adherence.
Liver and Heart Benefits:
Especially effective in conditions involving aldosterone excess, like liver cirrhosis or certain heart failure cases.
Balanced Electrolyte Management:
Offers a more stable electrolyte profile over time compared to Lasix monotherapy.

name: Aldactone 50mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET

ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET contains Spironolactone which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to manage fluid accumulation in the tissues due to heart disorders and in the abdominal cavity, severe heart failure (NYHA III-IV), and certain kidney disorders.

ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET is also used to manage high blood pressure along with a salt-free diet and diuretics. It can also be used to diagnose and manage Conn’s disease (a disorder in which excess levels of aldosterone is produced in the adrenal cortex).

Fluid regularly drains into body tissues from the blood. When this fluid isn’t removed from the tissue, fluid retention (edema) occurs, causing symptoms like swelling and aching of affected body parts such as feet, ankles, or hands.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several tests to understand your existing condition.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET. Before taking ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart, or kidney problems, or low sodium and high potassium levels.

ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women. It should be used in breastfeeding women only if specifically directed by your doctor, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children with moderate to severe kidney disease. It should be used with caution in elderly patients especially in patients having kidney diseases. Consult with your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET are enlarged breasts in men, headache, indigestion, diarrhea, extreme tiredness, and drowsiness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Conn’s disease

mechanismOfAction:
How ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET Works

ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET works by competitively binding to receptors at the aldosterone-dependent sodium-potassium exchange site in the kidney tubules, causing increased amounts of sodium and water to be excreted, while retaining potassium.

Do not stop taking ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney disorders like severe renal dysfunction. Consult your doctor before taking ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET.
ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver disorders. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Have low blood sodium levels
Have high blood potassium levels or associated conditions
Have Adison’s disease (your adrenal gland doesn’t produce sufficient hormones)

ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children with moderate to severe kidney disease. It should be used with caution in children with hypertension. They should be managed under guidance of a paediatrician. Consult your child’s doctor before giving ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET to your child.

 Use in geriatrics:

ALDACTONE 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially those with kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Hyzide 12.5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About HYZIDE 12.5MG TABLET

HYZIDE 12.5MG TABLET contains Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is as an adjuvant therapy in managing edema (fluid accumulation) that is caused due to heart failure, liver inflammation (Ex. liver cirrhosis), kidney problems or due to intake of steroid medications. It can also be used in the management of hypertension (high blood pressure) either alone or in combination with other medications.

During management with HYZIDE 12.5MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking HYZIDE 12.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, diabetes, low blood potassium levels, gout or electrolyte imbalance as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking HYZIDE 12.5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking HYZIDE 12.5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, constipation, muscle spasm, blurred vision and impotence. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage oedema (fluid accumulation in the body parts which causes swelling)
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:
Uses Of HYZIDE 12.5MG TABLET
Manage oedema (fluid accumulation in the body parts which causes swelling)
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How HYZIDE 12.5MG TABLET Works

HYZIDE 12.5MG TABLET is a diuretic. It acts by removing excess water from the body in the form of urine. This reduces swelling of body parts and manages fluid accumulation. It also reduces the thickness of blood which reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use HYZIDE 12.5MG TABLET

Take HYZIDE 12.5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take HYZIDE 12.5MG TABLET at the same time each day.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take HYZIDE 12.5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About MINIRIN 0.1MG TABLET

MINIRIN 0.1MG TABLET contains Desmopressin which belongs to the group of medicines called Synthetic antidiuretic peptide. It is used to manage cranial diabetes insipidus (occurs when there's not enough AVP in the body to regulate urine production). It also used to manage primary nocturnal enuresis (bed wetting from the age of 5) and nocturia in adults up to 65 years (night-time urine production exceeding bladder capacity).

Desmopressin works by reducing the amount of water that is eliminated in the urine. It enhances the reabsorption of water in the kidneys. Avoid drinking large amounts of water or fluid during this medication that leads to a build-up of water resulting in dilution of the salt in the body and may cause a serious problems or convulsions.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are dehydrated due to vomiting, diarrhea or systemic infections. There is an increased risk of pre-eclampsia during this medication, so inform your doctor if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. MINIRIN 0.1MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effect of taking MINIRIN 0.1MG TABLET are headache, stomach pain swelling of ankles. Consult your doctor for advice if you experience the above side effects for a long duration.

name: CTD 12.5mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About CTD 12.5MG TABLET

CTD 12.5mg Tablet is a commonly prescribed medication primarily used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and related cardiovascular conditions. It works by helping the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body, which in turn reduces the workload on the heart and lowers blood pressure. This makes it especially beneficial for patients who experience mild to moderate hypertension, swelling (edema), or fluid retention due to heart or kidney-related issues. Its once-daily formulation offers convenience and improves adherence, making it suitable for long-term use under medical supervision.     

CTD 12.5mg is ideal for adult patients with elevated blood pressure, mild fluid retention, or those requiring a low-dose diuretic as part of a combination therapy. Patients with conditions like heart failure or chronic kidney disease may also benefit when prescribed carefully by a healthcare provider. The tablet is usually taken once daily, preferably in the morning, with or without food. It is important to take it consistently at the same time each day and to follow the dosage instructions provided by the doctor to ensure optimal effectiveness and minimize side effects.  

When using CTD 12.5mg, patients should follow certain precautions and directions for use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolyte levels is recommended, especially in patients prone to low potassium or sodium levels. Patients should maintain adequate hydration and avoid excessive alcohol intake. Important warnings include monitoring for signs of dizziness, dehydration, or unusual fatigue. Those with a history of kidney or liver disease should discuss the suitability of this medication with their doctor before starting it.

For pregnant or breastfeeding women, CTD 12.5mg should only be used if clearly needed and under strict medical supervision, as its effects on the foetus or infant are not fully established. Common side effects may include mild dizziness, increased urination, fatigue, or slight gastrointestinal discomfort. Serious side effects are rare but require immediate medical attention. With proper adherence and monitoring, CTD 12.5mg can be an effective option for controlling blood pressure and supporting cardiovascular health in patients who require a gentle yet reliable diuretic therapy.
uses: Used to manage Hypertension

Used to manage Hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How CTD 12.5MG TABLET Works
Mechanism of Action of CTD 12.5mg Tablet

CTD 12.5mg Tablet contains Chlorthalidone, a thiazide-like diuretic that helps regulate fluid and salt balance in the body. It acts on the kidneys, specifically on the distal convoluted tubules, to block the reabsorption of sodium and chloride ions. This increases urine output and promotes the elimination of excess salt and water from the body. As a result, the overall blood volume decreases, leading to a reduction in blood pressure. Additionally, the tablet helps relax blood vessel walls over time, further aiding in smoother blood flow and improved heart function.

It can be taken with or without food, preferably at the same time each day for best results.
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.
Morning doses are generally preferred to avoid frequent urination during the night.
Do not skip or double the dose if you miss one take the next scheduled dose as directed.
Maintain adequate hydration and follow any specific diet recommendations, especially related to salt or potassium intake.
Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function is advised during continued use.

warnings.details: If you are pregnant, think you might be pregnant, or are planning to have a baby, it is important to consult your doctor before taking CTD 12.5mg Tablet. Your doctor will evaluate the potential benefits and risks before recommending its use.

If you are breastfeeding or planning to breastfeed, ask your doctor for advice before using CTD 12.5mg Tablet. The medicine may pass into breast milk and could affect your baby, so professional guidance is essential.

CTD 12.5mg Tablet should be used with caution in individuals with kidney-related problems such as reduced kidney function or severe renal impairment. Regular monitoring of kidney function is advised to ensure safe use.

CTD 12.5mg Tablet should be used with caution in people with liver problems, such as mild to moderate hepatic impairment. It is not recommended in cases of severe liver disease unless specifically advised by your doctor.
Do not take CTD 12.5mg Tablet if you are allergic to chlorthalidone or any of its inactive ingredients. Always inform your doctor about any history of allergic reactions to similar medicines.
CTD 12.5mg Tablet should be taken carefully in patients with heart conditions such as congestive heart failure or other cardiac disorders. Dose adjustments or regular monitoring may be required.
CTD 12.5mg Tablet should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 to 18 years). The dose and duration must be strictly as prescribed by the pediatric specialist.
Elderly patients (aged above 65 years) should take CTD 12.5mg Tablet under medical supervision. Kidney and heart functions should be regularly monitored to ensure safe and effective use.

Before taking TIDE 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Introduction About DYTOR PLUS 10MG TABLET

Dytor Plus 10mg tablet contains a combination of Torsemide, a loop diuretic, and Spironolactone, a potassium-sparing diuretic. This effective combination is used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and edema associated with heart conditions.

Dytor Plus 10mg tablet is recommended to take in the morning with food in order to avoid frequent urination at night time. For optimal results, it is advised to take it at the same time each day. The dosage and frequency depend on the condition being managed, and your doctor will determine the appropriate amount to improve your symptoms. Continue taking the medication for as long as it is prescribed by your doctor.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, low blood pressure, dehydration, changes in potassium levels. If you experience any severe symptoms, seek medical advice immediately. Dehydration is very common side effect of this medicine. It might lower down the level of calcium, sodium, and magnesium in the blood. Hence, regular monitoring of kidney function and electrolytes is important while taking this medicine. It might cause dizziness or tiredness, if happens rise slowly from sitting position or avoid driving.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. Also, let your doctor know if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women. Additionally, make sure to share all other medications you are currently taking, as they could interact with or be affected by this medicine.

02. How can staying active and managing fluid intake enhance the effects of Dytor Plus? What are some general lifestyle recommendations to promote heart health and overall well-being?

Aspect

	

Explanation

	

Lifestyle Tips




Staying Active

	

Physical activity can enhance circulation, improve heart function, and help in managing blood pressure. It works synergistically with Dytor Plus, which helps reduce fluid retention.

	

1. Engage in at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (e.g., walking, cycling) most days of the week.


 	

It can also support weight management, which is crucial for overall cardiovascular health.

	

2. Incorporate strength training exercises twice a week to improve muscle tone and metabolism.


 	 	

3. Avoid prolonged periods of inactivity; take short walks throughout the day.




Managing Fluid Intake

	

Dytor Plus helps remove excess fluid by increasing urination, but proper fluid management is still important. Too much fluid intake can counteract its effects.

	

1. Maintain hydration with water, but avoid excessive fluid intake to prevent overloading kidneys.


 	

Consuming the right amount of fluids helps prevent dehydration, which can worsen heart problems.

	

2. Limit caffeine and alcohol, as they can lead to dehydration and exacerbate fluid retention.


 	 	

3. Monitor your daily fluid intake to ensure it aligns with your doctor's recommendations.




Dietary Considerations

	

A balanced diet supports heart health and works in conjunction with Dytor Plus. Reducing sodium and eating nutrient-dense foods can enhance fluid management and overall wellness.

	

1. Follow a heart-healthy diet (e.g., DASH or Mediterranean diet). Focus on fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins.


 	 	

2. Limit high-sodium foods to help prevent fluid retention.


 	 	

3. Include potassium-rich foods (bananas, spinach, potatoes) to help balance sodium levels.




Monitoring Weight & Blood Pressure

	

Regular monitoring of weight and blood pressure helps assess the effectiveness of Dytor Plus in managing fluid retention and preventing complications.

	

1. Weigh yourself regularly and track changes to notice any sudden weight gain, which may indicate fluid buildup.


 	 	

2. Keep track of your blood pressure regularly to ensure it's within the target range.




Stress Management

	

Chronic stress can negatively impact heart health and fluid balance. Managing stress complements the benefits of Dytor Plus.

	

1. Practice relaxation techniques like deep breathing, meditation, or yoga.


 	 	

2. Ensure you are getting enough sleep (7-9 hours per night) to help manage stress and support overall health.




Avoiding Overexertion

	

Overexertion can strain the heart, especially when dealing with fluid imbalances.

	

1. Avoid intense physical activities that can lead to fatigue or excessive fluid loss.


 	 	

2. Listen to your body and adjust exercise intensity based on how you are feeling.

Description

	

Evidence/Effectiveness

Garlic is thought to help lower blood pressure by improving blood vessel dilation.

	

Some studies show garlic can lower blood pressure slightly, especially when consumed regularly.

	

1-2 cloves per day, or as garlic supplements.

1-2 cups daily of brewed hibiscus tea.

Magnesium helps regulate blood pressure and supports cardiovascular health.

200-400 mg/day, ideally from food sources (e.g., leafy greens, nuts).

Regular physical activity can reduce blood pressure by improving heart and vascular health.

	

Numerous studies show that aerobic exercise and resistance training can lower blood pressure over time.

	

At least 30 minutes of moderate activity most days of the week.

Potassium helps balance sodium levels in the body and supports heart health.

	

A high-potassium diet is associated with lower blood pressure.

Practices like meditation, deep breathing, and yoga can lower stress and BP.

	

Reducing stress has been shown to significantly impact blood pressure management.

	

10-30 minutes of meditation or yoga daily.

introduction:
Introduction About AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET

AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET is a combination of Amiloride and Hydrochlorothiazide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Potassium-sparing and Thiazide diuretics. It is used to lower blood pressure in hypertensive (high blood pressure) patients. Hypertension is a condition when the blood flows at high pressure inside the body, which may cause symptoms such as early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heart rhythms, vision changes and buzzing in the ears and may also cause chest pain and muscle tremors in severe cases, etc.

Hypertension can also lead to life-threatening events such as heart attack, stroke, heart failure, kidney damage, etc. AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET is also used in the management therapy for heart failure, hepatic cirrhosis with ascites (scarring of the liver caused by long-term liver damage) and fluid build-up.

AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET should not be used in patients with Addison's disease, diabetes, diabetic neuropathy, kidney failure, high blood calcium levels, high urea or creatinine levels, severe liver failure or severe liver disease and so on. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have acidosis or systemic erythematous lupus (SLE), inflammation or fluid in the lungs, eye pain, pressure in the eye, poor vision, a high blood potassium level, kidney disease, fluid and electrolyte imbalance in the body, liver disease, high cholesterol, gout, cancer, etc.

AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers or children less than 18 years of age. The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, skin rash, nausea and so on. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse or persist.

Maintenance therapy for hepatic cirrhosis with ascites and oedema, congestive heart disease and fluid retention.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET Works

AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET is a combination of amiloride and hydrochlorothiazide. Amiloride works by acting in tubules in the kidney and promoting the excretion of sodium and water from the body without losing potassium. Hydrochlorothiazide also works by acting in the kidney tubules and promoting the excretion of water and potassium from the body by managing the reabsorption of the water. As a result, it controls blood pressure and fluid buildup in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET

Take AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET. Your doctor will determine the correct dose, frequency and duration of the management for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET is not recommended during pregnancy, as it may harm the developing baby. Consult your doctor before taking AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET.

AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding mothers, as the medicine can pass through breastmilk and harm breastfed babies. Consult your doctor before taking AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate heavy machines if you feel weak, tired, dizzy, dazed or vertigo (spinning sensation of your head) after taking AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET.
Avoid consuming alcohol while taking AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET, as it can cause dizziness or fainting when standing up from a resting position.

AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease or other kidney problems such as anuria (failure of the kidneys to produce urine) and kidney failure and must be used with caution in patients suffering from abnormally high levels of blood urea and nitrogen (azotaemia). Consult your doctor for advice before taking AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET.

AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from severe liver failure or severe liver diseases such as hepatic cirrhosis and must be used with caution in patients suffering from liver problems or liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking AMIUR H 2.5/25MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About TORSID PLUS 5/50 TABLET

TORSID PLUS 5/50 TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking TORSID PLUS 5/50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORSID PLUS 5/50 TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking TORSID PLUS 5/50 TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. TORSID PLUS 5/50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

TORSID PLUS 5/50 TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TORSID PLUS 5/50 TABLET Works

TORSID PLUS 5/50 TABLET contains two medicines namely spironolactone and torsemide. Both spironolactone and torsemide acts by removing the excess water and electrolytes (sodium and chloride) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing blood pressure. Additionally, spironolactone can manage the loss of potassium via urine and can block the release of certain chemicals in the kidneys (aldosterone) that causes endocrine problems.
usageDetails:
How to use TORSID PLUS 5/50 TABLET

Take TORSID PLUS 5/50 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TORSID PLUS 5/50 TABLET unless your doctor tells you to stop.

name: Dytor Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About DYTOR INJECTION

DYTOR INJECTION is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition.

DYTOR INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage).

Before receiving DYTOR INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Safety and effectiveness in pregnant or breastfeeding women and children has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

DYTOR INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

How DYTOR INJECTION Works

DYTOR INJECTION inhibits reabsorption of sodium and chloride in kidney by increasing urinary excretion of sodium, chloride, and water.  Thus, removing excessive fluid from the body.

Safety and effectiveness of DYTOR INJECTION in breastfeeding women has not been established yet as it is not known if the medicine is excreted in the breastmilk. Hence it should be used with caution when administered to a nursing woman.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after receiving DYTOR INJECTION.

DYTOR INJECTION is not recommended for use in anuric patients (kidneys fail to produce urine). DYTOR INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney failure, and severe urinary flow disorders. The dose will be adjusted by your doctor.
DYTOR INJECTION is not recommended for patients with hepatic coma or pre-coma. DYTOR INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases like cirrhosis and ascites.
Do not receive DYTOR INJECTION if you are allergic to Torsemide or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
DYTOR INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart failure.
Safety and effectiveness of DYTOR INJECTION in children has not been established yet.
There is no information on dosage adjustments in elderly patients.

Others

DYTOR INJECTION is not recommended if you have:

Low volume of blood (hypovolaemia)
Low blood pressure (hypotension)

introduction:
Introduction About TIDE PLUS 10MG TABLET

Tide Plus 10mg Tablet is a prescription medicine, combines Spironolactone and Torsemide, both of which belong to the group of Diuretics (water pills). It is mainly used to remove excess fluid from the body and reduce oedema (swelling) caused by conditions affecting the heart, liver, or kidneys.

This medicine is also helpful in managing hyperaldosteronism (excess aldosterone secretion) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure not controlled by other drugs).

Tide Plus 10 Tablet is usually advised to be taken in the morning along with food to lower the chances of frequent urination at night and to reduce stomach discomfort. For best results, it is recommended to take the tablet at the same time every day, as this helps maintain a steady level of medicine in the body. The dosage and duration depend on your medical condition such as oedema, resistant hypertension, heart failure, liver disease, or kidney problems, and your doctor will decide the exact amount you need based on your health requirements. You should not adjust the dose on your own, and it is important to continue this medicine for as long as prescribed, even if your symptoms improve, to avoid a recurrence of fluid buildup, swelling, or high blood pressure.

Common side effects of Tide Plus 10 Tablet may include dizziness, frequent urination, headache, muscle pain, dehydration, diarrhea, nausea, electrolyte imbalance (especially potassium levels) and period pain. If any of these side effects continue or get worse, inform your doctor as they may suggest ways to manage or control them.

Before taking this medicine, it is important to discuss with your doctor if you have any existing liver problems, kidney disorders, are pregnant, or breastfeeding, and also share a list of all other medications, supplements, or herbal products you are taking since they may interact and affect how the medicine works.

mechanismOfAction:
How TIDE PLUS 10MG TABLET Works

Tide Plus 10mg Tablet combines Spironolactone and Torsemide, two diuretics that work synergistically to help regulate fluid balance in the body by increasing urine output and reducing excess water retention.

Understanding the Mechanism of Action

Torsemide acts on the kidneys’ loop of Henle to inhibit sodium and chloride reabsorption, promoting increased urine production, while Spironolactone blocks aldosterone receptors, reducing sodium retention and supporting potassium conservation.

Key Ingredients and Their Role
Torsemide: A loop diuretic that boosts the excretion of sodium, chloride, and water, aiding in rapid fluid reduction.
Spironolactone: A potassium-sparing diuretic that balances electrolytes by antagonizing aldosterone, minimizing potassium loss.
Impact on Kidney Function

By enhancing sodium and water excretion, Tide Plus 10mg Tablet supports kidney function in managing fluid overload, while helping maintain electrolyte balance to reduce the risk of imbalances often seen in kidney or heart-related conditions.

Role in Fluid Regulation

The combined action of both diuretics facilitates effective control of oedema and fluid retention associated with heart failure, liver cirrhosis, and kidney disorders, leading to improved comfort and cardiovascular health.
