introduction:
Introduction About LORVAS SR 1.5MG TABLET

LORVAS SR 1.5MG TABLET contains Indapamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Thiazide like diuretics. It is used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension). It can also be used alone or in combination with other medicines to manage high blood pressure (hypertension) in adults.

Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel wall is too high, resulting in early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, changes in vision, and buzzing in the ears.

Your doctor may advise to have a test to check how well your parathyroid gland is working and blood tests to check for low sodium or potassium levels or high calcium levels before taking LORVAS SR 1.5MG TABLET.

LORVAS SR 1.5MG TABLET should be avoided in patients with severe liver disease or conditions like hepatic encephalopathy (liver problems affect your brain and central nervous system), severe kidney disease and low level of potassium in blood.

Before taking LORVAS SR 1.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have heart rhythm problems, diabetes, gout, muscle disorders, eye pain or decrease in vision due to choroidal effusion (fluid collection in the vascular layer of the eye) or earlier penicillin or sulphonamide allergy and are an athlete.

LORVAS SR 1.5MG TABLET is not recommended among pregnant and breastfeeding women. LORVAS SR 1.5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and need to be used with caution among elderly patients with impaired kidney function.

The most common side effect of taking LORVAS SR 1.5MG TABLET is skin rashes. Contact your doctor if the side effects gets worsen.
uses: Used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension)
usesDetails:
Uses Of LORVAS SR 1.5MG TABLET
Used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension)
mechanismOfAction:
How LORVAS SR 1.5MG TABLET Works

LORVAS SR 1.5MG TABLET lowers blood pressure by removing the extra water and salt from the body through acting on kidney. It also widens the blood vessel and makes the blood flow easy through blood vessels. This combined effect lowers blood pressure more effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use LORVAS SR 1.5MG TABLET

Take LORVAS SR 1.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow LORVAS SR 1.5MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TORSID

TORSID is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking TORSID, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of TORSID in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking TORSID are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.

TORSID inhibits reabsorption of sodium and chloride in kidney by increasing urinary excretion of sodium, chloride, and water.  Thus, removing excessive fluid from the body.

name: ZYTANIX 5 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About ZYTANIX 5 TABLET

ZYTANIX 5 TABLET contains Metolazone which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used for the management of hypertension. Hypertension is defined as persistently increased blood pressure, that can show symptoms like headache, sweating, fast heartbeat, or throbbing sensation.

ZYTANIX 5 TABLET is also used to manage oedema accompanying congestive heart failure and renal failure. Fluid regularly drains into body tissues from the blood. When this fluid isn’t removed from the tissue, fluid retention (oedema) occurs, causing symptoms like swelling and aching of affected body parts such as feet, ankles, or hands.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Avoid consumption of alcohol with ZYTANIX 5 TABLET as it may drop your blood pressure. ZYTANIX 5 TABLET is not recommended for patients who have an inability to urinate or electrolyte disbalance and have comatose condition due to liver cirrhosis.

Before taking ZYTANIX 5 TABLET inform your doctor if you have kidney disorder, rheumatism, diabetes, infection, eye problems, or you are about to have any surgery. ZYTANIX 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult with your doctor for advice.

Safety and effectiveness of ZYTANIX 5 TABLET in children have not been established. It should be used with caution in elderly with reduced kidney function. The most common side effects of taking ZYTANIX 5 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, congestion, diarrhoea, muscle cramps, headache, dizziness, and tiredness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Fluid retention (oedema) in heart failure and kidney diseases

Uses Of ZYTANIX 5 TABLET

To manage:

Fluid retention (oedema) in heart failure and kidney diseases
Hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How ZYTANIX 5 TABLET Works

ZYTANIX 5 TABLET works by inhibiting sodium transport across the kidney resulting in a decrease in sodium reabsorption and an increase in sodium, chloride, and water excretion. This causes a decrease in the volume of fluid in the body and diuresis (increased urinary excretion) resolves fluid retention and contributing to the antihypertensive effect.
usageDetails:
How to use ZYTANIX 5 TABLET

Take ZYTANIX 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have a serious electrolyte imbalance in your blood

ZYTANIX 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients with kidney, liver or heart problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About TORSINEX PLUS TABLET

TORSINEX PLUS TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking TORSINEX PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORSINEX PLUS TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking TORSINEX PLUS TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. TORSINEX PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

TORSINEX PLUS TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TORSINEX PLUS TABLET Works

TORSINEX PLUS TABLET contains two medicines namely spironolactone and torsemide. Both spironolactone and torsemide acts by removing the excess water and electrolytes (sodium and chloride) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing blood pressure. Additionally, spironolactone can manage the loss of potassium via urine and can block the release of certain chemicals in the kidneys (aldosterone) that causes endocrine problems.
usageDetails:
How to use TORSINEX PLUS TABLET

Take TORSINEX PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TORSINEX PLUS TABLET unless your doctor tells you to stop.

warnings.details: TORSINEX PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
TORSINEX PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness, drowsiness, or blurred vision after taking TORSINEX PLUS TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORSINEX PLUS TABLET as it might make you feel dizzy or faint even when you change posture.

TORSINEX PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with moderate to severe kidney diseases (such as difficulty in passing urine or acute renal failure). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
TORSINEX PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients liver diseases. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TORSINEX PLUS TABLET if you are allergic to Torsemide, Spironolactone or sulfonylureas (Ex. glimepiride, glipizide).
TORSINEX PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart diseases (such as low blood pressure or abnormal heart rate). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

TORSINEX PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have high levels of potassium in your blood (hyperkalaemia)
Have Addison’s disease (deficiency of cortisol and aldosterone)

Use in paediatrics:

There is no proper information regarding the use of TORSINEX PLUS TABLET in children and adolescents (below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

TORSINEX PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

B. Drug-Food interactions

Avoid foods rich in potassium such as bananas, dry fruits, lentils, dairy products, and salt substitutes such as potassium chloride.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more TORSINEX PLUS TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose might include dehydration,
low blood pressure, decreased body fluids and electrolytes levels, low blood sodium levels, abnormal blood potassium levels, increased RBC count, drowsiness, mental confusion, erythematous rash, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, diarrhoea, or liver problems.

introduction:
Introduction About RETORLIX 5MG TABLET

RETORLIX 5MG TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking RETORLIX 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of RETORLIX 5MG TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking RETORLIX 5MG TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.

RETORLIX 5MG TABLET inhibits reabsorption of sodium and chloride in kidney by increasing urinary excretion of sodium, chloride, and water.  Thus, removing excessive fluid from the body.

Low volume of blood (hypovolaemia)
Low blood pressure (hypotension)

name: Lorvas 2.5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About LORVAS 2.5MG TABLET

LORVAS 2.5MG TABLET contains Indapamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Thiazide like diuretics. It is used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension). It can also be used alone or in combination with other medicines to manage high blood pressure (hypertension) in adults.

Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel wall is too high, resulting in early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, changes in vision, and buzzing in the ears.

Your doctor may advise to have a test to check how well your parathyroid gland is working and blood tests to check for low sodium or potassium levels or high calcium levels before taking LORVAS 2.5MG TABLET.

LORVAS 2.5MG TABLET should be avoided in patients with severe liver disease or conditions like hepatic encephalopathy (liver problems affect your brain and central nervous system), severe kidney disease and low level of potassium in blood.

Before taking LORVAS 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have heart rhythm problems, diabetes, gout, muscle disorders, eye pain or decrease in vision due to choroidal effusion (fluid collection in the vascular layer of the eye) or earlier penicillin or sulphonamide allergy and are an athlete.

LORVAS 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended among pregnant and breastfeeding women. LORVAS 2.5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and need to be used with caution among elderly patients with impaired kidney function.

The most common side effect of taking LORVAS 2.5MG TABLET is skin rashes. Contact your doctor if the side effects gets worsen.
uses: Used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension)

Used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension)

How LORVAS 2.5MG TABLET Works

LORVAS 2.5MG TABLET lowers blood pressure by removing the extra water and salt from the body through acting on kidney. It also widens the blood vessel and makes the blood flow easy through blood vessels. This combined effect lowers blood pressure more effectively.

introduction:
Introduction About EPTUS T10 KIT

EPTUS T10 KIT is a combination of Eplerenone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used in adults to manage high blood pressure and edema (swelling due to fluid retention) related to heart failure.

Hypertension is defined as persistently increased blood pressure, that can show symptoms like headache, sweating, fast heartbeat or throbbing sensation. Fluid regularly drains into body tissues from the blood. When this fluid isn’t removed from the tissue, fluid retention (edema) occurs, causing symptoms like swelling and aching of affected body parts such as feet, ankles or hands.

During course of the management your doctor might regularly monitor your kidney or liver function test to avoid any untoward side effects.

Before taking EPTUS T10 KIT, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, heart or liver problems, high or low blood potassium levels, diabetes, low blood volume or difficulty in passing urine.

EPTUS T10 KIT is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents due to lack of safety and effectiveness.

The most common side effects of taking EPTUS T10 KIT are muscle cramps, diarrhoea, nausea, dizziness, headache and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Manage high blood pressure and edema related to heart failure
usesDetails:
Uses Of EPTUS T10 KIT
Manage high blood pressure and edema related to heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How EPTUS T10 KIT Works

EPTUS T10 KIT lowers edema where eplerenone blocks aldosterone, which is a mineralocorticoid acting on epithelial (e.g., kidney) and nonepithelial (e.g., heart and blood vessels) receptors to cause sodium and water reabsorption, and torsemide induces excretion of sodium, chloride and water by inhibiting sodium and chloride reabsorption in kidney tubules.
usageDetails:
How to use EPTUS T10 KIT

Take EPTUS T10 KIT as advised by your physician. Swallow EPTUS T10 KIT with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking EPTUS T10 KIT unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About METOZ 5MG TABLET

METOZ 5MG TABLET contains Metolazone which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used for the management of hypertension. Hypertension is defined as persistently increased blood pressure, that can show symptoms like headache, sweating, fast heartbeat, or throbbing sensation.

METOZ 5MG TABLET is also used to manage oedema accompanying congestive heart failure and renal failure. Fluid regularly drains into body tissues from the blood. When this fluid isn’t removed from the tissue, fluid retention (oedema) occurs, causing symptoms like swelling and aching of affected body parts such as feet, ankles, or hands.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Avoid consumption of alcohol with METOZ 5MG TABLET as it may drop your blood pressure. METOZ 5MG TABLET is not recommended for patients who have an inability to urinate or electrolyte disbalance and have comatose condition due to liver cirrhosis.

Before taking METOZ 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have kidney disorder, rheumatism, diabetes, infection, eye problems, or you are about to have any surgery. METOZ 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult with your doctor for advice.

Safety and effectiveness of METOZ 5MG TABLET in children have not been established. It should be used with caution in elderly with reduced kidney function. The most common side effects of taking METOZ 5MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, congestion, diarrhoea, muscle cramps, headache, dizziness, and tiredness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How METOZ 5MG TABLET Works

METOZ 5MG TABLET works by inhibiting sodium transport across the kidney resulting in a decrease in sodium reabsorption and an increase in sodium, chloride, and water excretion. This causes a decrease in the volume of fluid in the body and diuresis (increased urinary excretion) resolves fluid retention and contributing to the antihypertensive effect.

introduction:
Introduction About TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET

TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.

Essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:

It is used to manage:

Oedema associated with congestive heart failure, kidney, or liver disease

mechanismOfAction:
How TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET Works

TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET inhibits reabsorption of sodium and chloride in kidney by increasing urinary excretion of sodium, chloride, and water.  Thus, removing excessive fluid from the body.

warnings.details: Safety and effectiveness of TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET in pregnant women or women planning to get pregnant has not been established yet. Hence it should be used during pregnancy only if clearly needed.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after taking TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET because it might make you feel dizzy or drowsy.

TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in anuric patients (kidneys fail to produce urine). TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with kidney failure, and severe urinary flow disorders. The dose will be adjusted by your doctor.
TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET is not recommended for patients with hepatic coma or pre-coma. TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver diseases like cirrhosis and ascites.
Do not take TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET if you are allergic to Torsemide or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart failure.
TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children as safety data has not been established yet.
There is no information on dosage adjustments in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET.

Others

TORVIGRESS 20MG TABLET is not recommended if you have:

Low volume of blood (hypovolaemia)
Low blood pressure (hypotension)

name: Planep T 20mg Kit 10's
introduction:
Introduction About PLANEP T 20MG KIT

PLANEP T 20MG KIT is a combination of Eplerenone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used in adults to manage high blood pressure and edema (swelling due to fluid retention) related to heart failure.

Hypertension is defined as persistently increased blood pressure, that can show symptoms like headache, sweating, fast heartbeat or throbbing sensation. Fluid regularly drains into body tissues from the blood. When this fluid isn’t removed from the tissue, fluid retention (edema) occurs, causing symptoms like swelling and aching of affected body parts such as feet, ankles or hands.

During course of the management your doctor might regularly monitor your kidney or liver function test to avoid any untoward side effects.

Before taking PLANEP T 20MG KIT, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, heart or liver problems, high or low blood potassium levels, diabetes, low blood volume or difficulty in passing urine.

PLANEP T 20MG KIT is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents due to lack of safety and effectiveness.

The most common side effects of taking PLANEP T 20MG KIT are muscle cramps, diarrhoea, nausea, dizziness, headache and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Manage high blood pressure and edema related to heart failure
usesDetails:
Uses Of PLANEP T 20MG KIT
Manage high blood pressure and edema related to heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How PLANEP T 20MG KIT Works

PLANEP T 20MG KIT lowers edema where eplerenone blocks aldosterone, which is a mineralocorticoid acting on epithelial (e.g., kidney) and nonepithelial (e.g., heart and blood vessels) receptors to cause sodium and water reabsorption, and torsemide induces excretion of sodium, chloride and water by inhibiting sodium and chloride reabsorption in kidney tubules.
usageDetails:
How to use PLANEP T 20MG KIT

Take PLANEP T 20MG KIT as advised by your physician. Swallow PLANEP T 20MG KIT with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking PLANEP T 20MG KIT unless your doctor advises you to stop.

PLANEP T 20MG KIT is not recommended for use in children and adolescents as its safety and effectiveness have not been established. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Your doctor will prescribe the right dose of PLANEP T 20MG KIT depending on your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TORSID PLUS 50/MG TABLET

TORSID PLUS 50/MG TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking TORSID PLUS 50/MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORSID PLUS 50/MG TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking TORSID PLUS 50/MG TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. TORSID PLUS 50/MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

TORSID PLUS 50/MG TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

TORSID PLUS 50/MG TABLET contains two medicines namely spironolactone and torsemide. Both spironolactone and torsemide acts by removing the excess water and electrolytes (sodium and chloride) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing blood pressure. Additionally, spironolactone can manage the loss of potassium via urine and can block the release of certain chemicals in the kidneys (aldosterone) that causes endocrine problems.

Take TORSID PLUS 50/MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About MINIRIN MELT 120MCG TABLET

MINIRIN MELT 120MCG TABLET contains Desmopressin which belongs to the group of medicines called Synthetic antidiuretic peptide. It is used to manage cranial diabetes insipidus (occurs when there's not enough AVP in the body to regulate urine production). It also used to manage primary nocturnal enuresis (bed wetting from the age of 5) and nocturia in adults up to 65 years (night-time urine production exceeding bladder capacity).

Desmopressin works by reducing the amount of water that is eliminated in the urine. It enhances the reabsorption of water in the kidneys. Avoid drinking large amounts of water or fluid during this medication that leads to a build-up of water resulting in dilution of the salt in the body and may cause a serious problems or convulsions.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are dehydrated due to vomiting, diarrhea or systemic infections. There is an increased risk of pre-eclampsia during this medication, so inform your doctor if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. MINIRIN MELT 120MCG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effect of taking MINIRIN MELT 120MCG TABLET are headache, stomach pain swelling of ankles. Consult your doctor for advice if you experience the above side effects for a long duration.

How MINIRIN MELT 120MCG TABLET Works

MINIRIN MELT 120MCG TABLET mimics the action of endogenous anti-diuretic hormone. After administration, desmopressin works by reducing the amount of water that is eliminated in the urine. It enhances the reabsorption of water in the kidneys.

Always take MINIRIN MELT 120MCG TABLET as directed by your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Avoid drinking large amounts of water while taking MINIRIN MELT 120MCG TABLET since it could lead to a build-up of water leading to serious problems or convulsions.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Mouth Dissolving Tablet: It should be placed under the tongue where it dissolves without the need for water.

Introduction About TORSID PLUS 20/50 TABLET

TORSID PLUS 20/50 TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking TORSID PLUS 20/50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORSID PLUS 20/50 TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking TORSID PLUS 20/50 TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. TORSID PLUS 20/50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

TORSID PLUS 20/50 TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

Introduction About TIDE 10MG TABLET

TIDE 10MG TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking TIDE 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of TIDE 10MG TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking TIDE 10MG TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.

introduction:
Introduction About ZYTANIX 2.5 TABLET

ZYTANIX 2.5 TABLET contains Metolazone which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used for the management of hypertension. Hypertension is defined as persistently increased blood pressure, that can show symptoms like headache, sweating, fast heartbeat, or throbbing sensation.

ZYTANIX 2.5 TABLET is also used to manage oedema accompanying congestive heart failure and renal failure. Fluid regularly drains into body tissues from the blood. When this fluid isn’t removed from the tissue, fluid retention (oedema) occurs, causing symptoms like swelling and aching of affected body parts such as feet, ankles, or hands.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Avoid consumption of alcohol with ZYTANIX 2.5 TABLET as it may drop your blood pressure. ZYTANIX 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for patients who have an inability to urinate or electrolyte disbalance and have comatose condition due to liver cirrhosis.

Before taking ZYTANIX 2.5 TABLET inform your doctor if you have kidney disorder, rheumatism, diabetes, infection, eye problems, or you are about to have any surgery. ZYTANIX 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult with your doctor for advice.

Safety and effectiveness of ZYTANIX 2.5 TABLET in children have not been established. It should be used with caution in elderly with reduced kidney function. The most common side effects of taking ZYTANIX 2.5 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, congestion, diarrhoea, muscle cramps, headache, dizziness, and tiredness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZYTANIX 2.5 TABLET Works

ZYTANIX 2.5 TABLET works by inhibiting sodium transport across the kidney resulting in a decrease in sodium reabsorption and an increase in sodium, chloride, and water excretion. This causes a decrease in the volume of fluid in the body and diuresis (increased urinary excretion) resolves fluid retention and contributing to the antihypertensive effect.

introduction:
Introduction About TORMAX PLUS LS TABLET

TORMAX PLUS LS TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking TORMAX PLUS LS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORMAX PLUS LS TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking TORMAX PLUS LS TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. TORMAX PLUS LS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

TORMAX PLUS LS TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

Both spironolactone and torsemide acts by removing the excess water and electrolytes (sodium and chloride) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing blood pressure. Additionally, spironolactone can manage the loss of potassium via urine and can block the release of certain chemicals in the kidneys (aldosterone) that causes endocrine problems.

introduction:
Introduction About TORSIVAC 5 TABLET

TORSIVAC 5 TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking TORSIVAC 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of TORSIVAC 5 TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking TORSIVAC 5 TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.
uses: Oedema associated with congestive heart failure, kidney, or liver disease
Essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:

Oedema associated with congestive heart failure, kidney, or liver disease
Essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How TORSIVAC 5 TABLET Works

TORSIVAC 5 TABLET inhibits reabsorption of sodium and chloride in kidney by increasing urinary excretion of sodium, chloride, and water.  Thus, removing excessive fluid from the body.

Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Do not stop taking TORSIVAC 5 TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORSIVAC 5 TABLET because it might make you feel dizzy or drowsy.

Do not take TORSIVAC 5 TABLET if you are allergic to Torsemide or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
TORSIVAC 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart failure.
TORSIVAC 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children as safety data has not been established yet.
There is no information on dosage adjustments in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking TORSIVAC 5 TABLET.

Others

Low volume of blood (hypovolaemia)
Low blood pressure (hypotension)

name: JBTOR PLUS 10 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About JBTOR PLUS 10 TABLET

JBTOR PLUS 10 TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking JBTOR PLUS 10 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking JBTOR PLUS 10 TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking JBTOR PLUS 10 TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. JBTOR PLUS 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

JBTOR PLUS 10 TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

Hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body)
Resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines)

mechanismOfAction:
How JBTOR PLUS 10 TABLET Works

JBTOR PLUS 10 TABLET contains two medicines namely spironolactone and torsemide. Both spironolactone and torsemide acts by removing the excess water and electrolytes (sodium and chloride) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing blood pressure. Additionally, spironolactone can manage the loss of potassium via urine and can block the release of certain chemicals in the kidneys (aldosterone) that causes endocrine problems.

Take JBTOR PLUS 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

JBTOR PLUS 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About MINIRIN MELT 60MCG TABLET

MINIRIN MELT 60MCG TABLET contains Desmopressin which belongs to the group of medicines called Synthetic antidiuretic peptide. It is used to manage cranial diabetes insipidus (occurs when there's not enough AVP in the body to regulate urine production). It also used to manage primary nocturnal enuresis (bed wetting from the age of 5) and nocturia in adults up to 65 years (night-time urine production exceeding bladder capacity).

Desmopressin works by reducing the amount of water that is eliminated in the urine. It enhances the reabsorption of water in the kidneys. Avoid drinking large amounts of water or fluid during this medication that leads to a build-up of water resulting in dilution of the salt in the body and may cause a serious problems or convulsions.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are dehydrated due to vomiting, diarrhea or systemic infections. There is an increased risk of pre-eclampsia during this medication, so inform your doctor if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. MINIRIN MELT 60MCG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effect of taking MINIRIN MELT 60MCG TABLET are headache, stomach pain swelling of ankles. Consult your doctor for advice if you experience the above side effects for a long duration.

Primary nocturnal enuresis
Nocturia (in adults up to 65 years of age)

How MINIRIN MELT 60MCG TABLET Works

MINIRIN MELT 60MCG TABLET mimics the action of endogenous anti-diuretic hormone. After administration, desmopressin works by reducing the amount of water that is eliminated in the urine. It enhances the reabsorption of water in the kidneys.

Always take MINIRIN MELT 60MCG TABLET as directed by your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Avoid drinking large amounts of water while taking MINIRIN MELT 60MCG TABLET since it could lead to a build-up of water leading to serious problems or convulsions.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Mouth Dissolving Tablet: It should be placed under the tongue where it dissolves without the need for water.

introduction:
Introduction About FUROPED SOLUTION

FUROPED SOLUTION contains Furosemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. FUROPED SOLUTION is used to remove excess water from the body due to lung, kidney, heart, liver and/or blood vessel problems. Oedema is a condition that occurs due to the accumulation of fluid in the body and is generally characterized by symptoms such as swelling or pain in the arms or legs and/or in affected joints, an increase in the size and puffiness of the tissue under the skin, etc.

FUROPED SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with low blood volume, an inability to pass urine, liver problems (such as severe liver failure) and/or kidney problems (such as kidney failure). Before taking FUROPED SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure, porphyria, fits or seizures, a brain injury or brain disease, gout and/or diabetes.

FUROPED SOLUTION should be used with caution during pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women, children or adolescents (below 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking FUROPED SOLUTION are dehydration, excessive loss of body fluids, signs of sodium deficiency (such as cramps in the calf muscle, loss of appetite and weakness) and signs of potassium deficiency (such as muscular weakness and/or paralysis). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.
uses: Manage fluid retention in the body
usesDetails:
Uses Of FUROPED SOLUTION
Manage fluid retention in the body
mechanismOfAction:
How FUROPED SOLUTION Works

FUROPED SOLUTION works by blocking tubular reabsorption of sodium & chloride in kidneys and promotes diuresis (increased production of urine) which results in increased excretion of water along with magnesium, calcium, hydrogen, sodium and chloride thus removing excess fluid from the body and thereby providing relief from oedema in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use FUROPED SOLUTION

Take FUROPED SOLUTION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

FUROPED SOLUTION is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel less alert than normal after using FUROPED SOLUTION.
FUROPED SOLUTION should be used with caution in alcoholic individuals, only if recommended by your doctor as it may harm or worsen your condition. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
FUROPED SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems such as severe liver failure. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
FUROPED SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with kidney problems such as kidney failure or hepatorenal syndrome. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
Do not take FUROPED SOLUTION if you are allergic to Furosemide, sulphonamides or any of the other ingredients in this medicine.

Others

FUROPED SOLUTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have signs of low water level in the body such as weakness, difficulty in breathing and light-headedness
Are dehydrated
Have signs of low blood volume such as pale skin, feeling dizzy, faint/nauseous and/or feeling very thirsty
Are unable to pass urine or pass very little urine
Have signs of very low potassium/sodium levels in the blood such as muscle cramps, weakness and tiredness
Suffer from coma

Before using FUROPED SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have signs of low blood pressure such as dizziness, feeling less alert than usual fainting and general weakness
Have difficulty passing urine especially due to an enlarged prostate gland
Have gout
Have signs of low potassium level in the blood such as swelling, nausea/vomiting, diarrhoea and/or stomach pain
Have brain disorders (affecting your nervous system) or porphyria (blood disorder) associated with symptoms such as skin blisters, pain in and around the stomach area
Have diabetes

Use in Pediatrics:

FUROPED SOLUTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Use in Geriatrics:

FUROPED SOLUTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) especially those who suffer from dementia. Consult your doctor taking the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About TORSEPURE 10 TABLET

TORSEPURE 10 TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking TORSEPURE 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of TORSEPURE 10 TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking TORSEPURE 10 TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.

TORSEPURE 10 TABLET inhibits reabsorption of sodium and chloride in kidney by increasing urinary excretion of sodium, chloride, and water.  Thus, removing excessive fluid from the body.

warnings.details: Safety and effectiveness of TORSEPURE 10 TABLET in pregnant women or women planning to get pregnant has not been established yet. Hence it should be used during pregnancy only if clearly needed.

Safety and effectiveness of TORSEPURE 10 TABLET in breastfeeding women has not been established yet as it is not known if the medicine is excreted in the breastmilk. Hence it should be used with caution when administered to a nursing woman.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after taking TORSEPURE 10 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORSEPURE 10 TABLET because it might make you feel dizzy or drowsy.

TORSEPURE 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in anuric patients (kidneys fail to produce urine). TORSEPURE 10 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with kidney failure, and severe urinary flow disorders. The dose will be adjusted by your doctor.
TORSEPURE 10 TABLET is not recommended for patients with hepatic coma or pre-coma. TORSEPURE 10 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver diseases like cirrhosis and ascites.
Do not take TORSEPURE 10 TABLET if you are allergic to Torsemide or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
TORSEPURE 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart failure.
TORSEPURE 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in children as safety data has not been established yet.
There is no information on dosage adjustments in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking TORSEPURE 10 TABLET.

Others

TORSEPURE 10 TABLET is not recommended if you have:

Low volume of blood (hypovolaemia)
Low blood pressure (hypotension)

introduction:
Introduction About DURITE PLUS 10 TABLET

DURITE PLUS 10 TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking DURITE PLUS 10 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DURITE PLUS 10 TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking DURITE PLUS 10 TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. DURITE PLUS 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

DURITE PLUS 10 TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

introduction:
Introduction About NATRILIX SR TABLET

Natrilix SR 1.5 mg Tablet is a sustained-release formulation containing Indapamide, a thiazide-like diuretic. It is commonly used to support the management of high blood pressure (hypertension), especially in patients who may benefit from fluid reduction as part of their overall blood pressure control. By helping the kidneys eliminate excess salt and water through urine, Natrilix SR reduces the volume of circulating blood, which in turn helps relax blood vessels and lower pressure within them. This tablet is ideal for individuals with salt-sensitive hypertension, elderly patients, or those who do not respond well to other classes of antihypertensives.

Natrilix SR is typically prescribed as a once-daily tablet, taken preferably in the morning to avoid increased urination during nighttime. It can be taken with or without food. The sustained-release nature of the tablet ensures a gradual and prolonged effect, promoting stable blood pressure control throughout the day. Patients are advised to take the tablet at the same time each day and not to skip or stop it without medical advice. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and blood electrolyte levels (like potassium and sodium) is usually recommended during treatment.

While generally well tolerated, certain precautions should be followed. Natrilix SR may cause dizziness, especially when standing up quickly, due to its blood pressure-lowering effect. It may also lead to low potassium or sodium levels, so your doctor may monitor your blood through periodic tests. Alcohol intake should be limited as it can amplify the risk of dizziness or fainting. Patients with severe kidney or liver problems, very low electrolyte levels, or those on lithium therapy should avoid this medicine unless carefully supervised.

Use of Natrilix SR 1.5 mg is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding, as safety data in these groups is limited. Commonly reported side effects include fatigue, muscle cramps, headache, increased urination, or gastrointestinal discomfort. Any signs of severe weakness, irregular heartbeat, or allergic reaction (such as rash or swelling) should be reported immediately. As with any long-term medication, it is essential to follow medical advice closely and adopt supportive lifestyle changes like a low-salt diet, regular exercise, and stress management for optimal results.

mechanismOfAction:
How NATRILIX SR TABLET Works
Natrilix SR 1.5 mg Mechanism of Action

Natrilix SR 1.5 mg contains Indapamide, a thiazide-like diuretic. It works by acting on the kidneys to remove excess sodium and water from the body through urine. This process reduces the volume of fluid in blood vessels, helping them relax and widen. As a result, it lowers blood pressure and eases the workload on the heart.

 How Does Natrilix SR 1.5 mg Control Blood Pressure

Natrilix SR helps control high blood pressure by reducing the amount of fluid in your blood vessels. It removes extra salt and water, which decreases the pressure inside the arteries. Over time, it also improves the elasticity of blood vessels, making it easier for blood to flow. This combined effect helps keep blood pressure within a healthy range.

 Natrilix SR 1.5 mg Diuretic Effect

As a diuretic or "water pill," Natrilix SR increases the amount of urine your body makes. It promotes the removal of salt and water from your bloodstream through the kidneys. This helps reduce swelling in certain conditions and supports long-term blood pressure control. Unlike strong loop diuretics, its diuretic effect is mild and steady, making it suitable for daily use in hypertension.

name: Spiromide Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SPIROMIDE TABLET

SPIROMIDE TABLET is a combination medication containing spironolactone (a potassium-sparing diuretic) and furosemide (a loop diuretic). It is commonly prescribed by healthcare professionals to help manage fluid retention while maintaining appropriate potassium levels. This formulation works by promoting the removal of excess fluid from the body without causing significant potassium loss.

It is recommended to take SPIROMIDE TABLET in the morning with food to help reduce frequent urination during the night. For optimal results, try to take it at the same time each day. The dosage and frequency will depend on the condition being managed, as determined by your doctor. Continue taking the medication for the full duration prescribed by your doctor.

Common side effect of this medication includes dehydration, dryness of mouth, thirst, weakness, lethargy, muscle pains, low blood pressure, dizziness, headache, nausea or vomiting, gynecomastia (in males), increased urination and electrolyte imbalance. Therefore, it is important to regularly monitor kidney function and electrolyte levels while taking this medication.

Before taking SPIROMIDE TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are severely dehydrated or have diabetes, gout, prostate problems, or low blood pressure which makes you feel dizzy while standing up or changing position. It is not recommended for use in patients with severe low sodium levels in their blood. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.
uses: Edema (fluid retention)
usesDetails:
Uses Of SPIROMIDE TABLET
Edema (fluid retention)
mechanismOfAction:
How SPIROMIDE TABLET Works

SPIROMIDE TABLET works by combining two diuretics such as spironolactone and furosemide to effectively remove excess fluid from the body while maintaining electrolyte balance. Furosemide acts on the loop of Henle in the kidneys to increase the excretion of sodium, chloride, and water, leading to rapid diuresis and relief from fluid overload. Meanwhile, spironolactone blocks the action of aldosterone, reducing sodium retention and preventing the loss of potassium. Together, they promote fluid removal in conditions like heart failure, liver cirrhosis, or kidney disease while minimizing the risk of potassium deficiency.

usageDetails:
How to use SPIROMIDE TABLET

Follow your doctor's instructions regarding the exact dosage. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not stop the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel better.

How to Take SPIROMIDE TABLET ?

Dosage: Take exactly as prescribed by your doctor, usually once daily, preferably in the morning to avoid nighttime urination.

With or without food: It can be taken with food to reduce stomach upset.

Swallow whole: Do not crush or chew the tablet.

Stay hydrated: Drink adequate water unless otherwise advised by your doctor.

Avoid high-potassium foods (like bananas, oranges) unless directed, as spironolactone can increase potassium levels.

Regular monitoring: Your doctor may ask for periodic blood tests to monitor electrolytes and kidney function.

Practical Tips for Users:
Setting Reminders: Consider using a daily alarm or reminder on your phone to ensure you take your medication at the same time every day.
Track Your Doses: Keeping a simple medication log can help you track when you have taken the medication, making it easier to avoid missed doses.
Avoid Overdosing: Do not exceed the recommended dosage. If you accidentally take more than prescribed, contact your doctor immediately.
sideEffects: High potassium (hyperkalemia) symptoms such as muscle weakness, irregular heartbeat, or palpitations, tingling or numbness (especially around the mouth or in hands/feet), sudden fatigue
Allergic reaction symptoms such as swelling of face, lips, tongue, or throat, difficulty breathing, severe skin rash or itching
Severe dehydration or electrolyte imbalance symptoms such as dizziness or fainting, confusion or mental changes, extreme thirst or dry mouth, muscle cramps or weakness
Kidney problems symptoms such as little or no urine output, swelling in legs or feet, rapid weight gain
Liver problem symptoms such as yellowing of the skin or eyes (jaundice), dark urine, pale stools, abdominal pain or swelling

name: Meltor 5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MELTOR 5MG TABLET

MELTOR 5MG TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking MELTOR 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of MELTOR 5MG TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking MELTOR 5MG TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.

introduction:
Introduction About LASIWIN 40MG TABLET

LASIWIN 40MG TABLET contains frusemide (furosemide) which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to manage edema (fluid retention) due to problems with your heart, lungs, kidneys, liver, blood vessels or high blood pressure. Generally, accumulation of excess fluid in the body adds extra pressure on your heart, blood vessels, lungs, kidneys or liver and can cause swelling of the ankles, breathing difficulties or even make you feel more tired than usual.

During the course of management with LASIWIN 40MG TABLET, your doctor will recommend you take several blood tests to monitor your blood sugar and uric acid levels as a precaution to avoid unwanted side effects. They may also monitor your blood potassium and sodium levels carefully, especially if you have vomiting or diarrhea.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver or heart problems. LASIWIN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. LASIWIN 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in children over 12 years of age. Also, it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking LASIWIN 40MG TABLET are dehydration, electrolyte imbalance and decreased blood volume. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens or persist for a long period of time.
uses: Manage edema (fluid retention)
usesDetails:
Uses Of LASIWIN 40MG TABLET
Manage edema (fluid retention)
mechanismOfAction:
How LASIWIN 40MG TABLET Works

LASIWIN 40MG TABLET contains frusemide which is a loop diuretic. It works by inhibiting the reabsorption of sodium and chloride in the proximal and distal tubules and in the thick ascending loop of Henle by inhibiting the sodium-chloride cotransport system. As a result, it promotes diuresis (urine output) by enhancing the excretion of water along with sodium, chloride, magnesium and calcium.
usageDetails:
How to use LASIWIN 40MG TABLET

Take LASIWIN 40MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow LASIWIN 40MG TABLET as whole with a sip of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take LASIWIN 40MG TABLET, as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

LASIWIN 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking LASIWIN 40MG TABLET.

Others

LASIWIN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are dehydrated
Have low levels of sodium, potassium or other electrolytes in the blood
Have low blood volume
Have addison’s disease
Have digitalis poisoning

Before taking LASIWIN 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have hypovolaemia (low blood volume)
Have hypoproteinemia (low levels of proteins in blood) due to kidney damage
Have prostate trouble or difficulty in passing urine
Have diabetes
Have gout (painful or inflamed joints)
Have an abnormal blood condition
Are going to undergo any blood or urine test

faqs.question: Q: Will LASIWIN 40MG TABLET make me feel tired?
faqs.answer: A: LASIWIN 40MG TABLET may cause hypotension (decrease in blood pressure) in some individuals and feeling of extreme tiredness or fainting can be attributed to this. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual symptoms after taking LASIWIN 40MG TABLET.

faqs.question: Q: Will LASIWIN 40MG TABLET increase the urge to pass urine?
faqs.answer: A: No, although LASIWIN 40MG TABLET acts by increasing urine output, it only increases the frequency of urine output and not the urge to pass urine. Consult your doctor if you experience any symptoms of urinary incontinence or if you have any bladder problems.

faqs.answer: A: LASIWIN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you become pregnant while taking LASIWIN 40MG TABLET talk to your doctor to check the growth of the baby. Consult your doctor before taking LASIWIN 40MG TABLET.

uses: Oedema associated with congestive heart failure, kidney, or liver disease

usesDetails:
Uses Of DYTOR 100MG TABLET

Essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How DYTOR 100MG TABLET Works

DYTOR 100MG TABLET inhibits reabsorption of sodium and chloride in kidney by increasing urinary excretion of sodium, chloride, and water.  Thus, removing excessive fluid from the body.
usageInstructions: Take DYTOR 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water.
Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
Do not stop taking DYTOR 100MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About TIDE E 20 COMBI KIT

TIDE E 20 COMBI KIT is a combination of Eplerenone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used in adults to manage high blood pressure and edema (swelling due to fluid retention) related to heart failure.

Hypertension is defined as persistently increased blood pressure, that can show symptoms like headache, sweating, fast heartbeat or throbbing sensation. Fluid regularly drains into body tissues from the blood. When this fluid isn’t removed from the tissue, fluid retention (edema) occurs, causing symptoms like swelling and aching of affected body parts such as feet, ankles or hands.

During course of the management your doctor might regularly monitor your kidney or liver function test to avoid any untoward side effects.

Before taking TIDE E 20 COMBI KIT, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, heart or liver problems, high or low blood potassium levels, diabetes, low blood volume or difficulty in passing urine.

TIDE E 20 COMBI KIT is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents due to lack of safety and effectiveness.

The most common side effects of taking TIDE E 20 COMBI KIT are muscle cramps, diarrhoea, nausea, dizziness, headache and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Manage high blood pressure and edema related to heart failure
usesDetails:
Uses Of TIDE E 20 COMBI KIT
Manage high blood pressure and edema related to heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How TIDE E 20 COMBI KIT Works

TIDE E 20 COMBI KIT lowers edema where eplerenone blocks aldosterone, which is a mineralocorticoid acting on epithelial (e.g., kidney) and nonepithelial (e.g., heart and blood vessels) receptors to cause sodium and water reabsorption, and torsemide induces excretion of sodium, chloride and water by inhibiting sodium and chloride reabsorption in kidney tubules.
usageDetails:
How to use TIDE E 20 COMBI KIT

Take TIDE E 20 COMBI KIT as advised by your physician. Swallow TIDE E 20 COMBI KIT with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TIDE E 20 COMBI KIT unless your doctor advises you to stop.

name: MINIRIN MELT 60mcg Orally Lyophilisate Tablet 30's
introduction:
Introduction About MINIRIN MELT 60MG ORALLY LIYOFILIZAT TABLET

MINIRIN MELT 60MG ORALLY LIYOFILIZAT TABLET contains Desmopressin which belongs to the group of medicines called Synthetic antidiuretic peptide. It is used to manage cranial diabetes insipidus (occurs when there's not enough AVP in the body to regulate urine production). It also used to manage primary nocturnal enuresis (bed wetting from the age of 5) and nocturia in adults up to 65 years (night-time urine production exceeding bladder capacity).

Desmopressin works by reducing the amount of water that is eliminated in the urine. It enhances the reabsorption of water in the kidneys. Avoid drinking large amounts of water or fluid during this medication that leads to a build-up of water resulting in dilution of the salt in the body and may cause a serious problems or convulsions.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are dehydrated due to vomiting, diarrhea or systemic infections. There is an increased risk of pre-eclampsia during this medication, so inform your doctor if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. MINIRIN MELT 60MG ORALLY LIYOFILIZAT TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effect of taking MINIRIN MELT 60MG ORALLY LIYOFILIZAT TABLET are headache, stomach pain swelling of ankles. Consult your doctor for advice if you experience the above side effects for a long duration.

Nocturia (in adults up to 65 years of age)

How MINIRIN MELT 60MG ORALLY LIYOFILIZAT TABLET Works

MINIRIN MELT 60MG ORALLY LIYOFILIZAT TABLET mimics the action of endogenous anti-diuretic hormone. After administration, desmopressin works by reducing the amount of water that is eliminated in the urine. It enhances the reabsorption of water in the kidneys.
usageDetails:
How to use MINIRIN MELT 60MG ORALLY LIYOFILIZAT TABLET

Always take MINIRIN MELT 60MG ORALLY LIYOFILIZAT TABLET as directed by your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Avoid drinking large amounts of water while taking MINIRIN MELT 60MG ORALLY LIYOFILIZAT TABLET since it could lead to a build-up of water leading to serious problems or convulsions.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Mouth Dissolving Tablet: It should be placed under the tongue where it dissolves without the need for water.

Cystic fibrosis
Difficulty in passing water

Introduction About LASIX 40MG INJECTION

LASIX 40MG INJECTION contains frusemide (furosemide) which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to manage edema (fluid retention) due to problems with heart, lungs, kidneys, liver, blood vessels or high blood pressure. Parenteral administration of LASIX 40MG INJECTION is indicated when a quick and effective removal of excess fluid is required or if the patient cannot take oral medication for any reason. Whenever possible, the patient must be switched to oral medicines in order to avoid unwanted risks of parenteral medication.  

During the course of management with LASIX 40MG INJECTION, your doctor will recommend you take several blood tests to monitor your blood sugar and uric acid levels as a precaution to avoid unwanted side effects. They may also monitor your blood potassium and sodium levels carefully, especially if you have vomiting or diarrhea. Before receiving this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver or heart problems. LASIX 40MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women.

LASIX 40MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) under careful medical supervision. Also, it should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before receiving LASIX 40MG INJECTION. The common side effects of receiving LASIX 40MG INJECTION are vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, dry mouth, thirst and feeling of tiredness. Inform your doctor immediately if any of the side effects worsen or persist for a long period of time.

mechanismOfAction:
How LASIX 40MG INJECTION Works

LASIX 40MG INJECTION contains frusemide which is a loop diuretic which works by inhibiting the reabsorption of sodium and chloride in the proximal and distal tubules, and in the thick ascending loop of Henle by inhibiting the sodium-chloride cotransport system. As a result, it promotes diuresis (urine output) by enhancing the excretion of water along with sodium, chloride, magnesium and calcium.
usageDetails:
How to use LASIX 40MG INJECTION

LASIX 40MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or nurse into the vein (intravenously) or muscle (intramuscularly). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of LASIX 40MG INJECTION for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving LASIX 40MG INJECTION as it may lead to excessive lowering of blood pressure.

LASIX 40MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver problems (cirrhosis). It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving LASIX 40MG INJECTION.
Do not receive LASIX 40MG INJECTION if you are allergic to frusemide (furosemide) or sulphonamide antibiotics (such as sulfadiazine).
LASIX 40MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before receiving LASIX 40MG INJECTION.

LASIX 40MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) under careful medical supervision. Your child’s doctor may adjust the dose on the basis of the severity of the renal insufficiency and on the response to initial doses. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of LASIX 40MG INJECTION .
LASIX 40MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before receiving LASIX 40MG INJECTION.

Others

LASIX 40MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have a low blood volume or severely dehydrated (with or without accompanying low blood pressure)
Have too little potassium or sodium in your blood (shown in blood test)
Are not passing any water (urine)
Have addison's disease
Have porphyria (characterized by abdominal pain, vomiting or muscle weakness)

Before receiving LASIX 40MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Feel dizzy when you are standing up
Are dehydrated (water loss due to vomiting, diarrhea, passing urine often and trouble drinking or eating)
Have difficulty in passing water (due to an enlarged prostate)
Have diabetes
Have gout (painful or inflamed joints)
Have low blood protein levels (hypoproteinaemia)
Have raised levels of calcium in the blood

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before receiving LASIX 40MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage irregular heartbeat (Ex. digoxin, amiodarone, sotalol, dofetilide and ibutilide)
Medicines used to reduce high blood pressure such as thiazide diuretics (Ex. bendroflumethiazide or hydrochlorothiazide), ACE inhibitors (Ex. lisinopril) or angiotensin II-receptor blockers (Ex. losartan)
Medicines used to reduce high cholesterol levels in blood (Ex. clofibrate, colestyramine and colestipol)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. insulin and metformin)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (Ex. aspirin or celecoxib)
Corticosteroids (used to manage pain or inflammation) Ex. dexamethasone, prednisolone
Medicines used to manage stomach ulcers (Ex. sucralfate or carbenoxolone)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine or phenobarbital)
Antibiotics (used to manage bacterial infections) such as aminoglycosides (Ex. streptomycin), cephalosporins, polymyxins or quinolones  
Medicines used to increase blood pressure (Ex. tyramine, tryptamine, and phenylethylamine)
Laxatives (used to manage constipation) Ex. lactulose, polyethylene glycol
Skeletal muscle relaxants given during operations (Ex. tubocurarine, curarine derivates and succinylcholine)

Overdosage:

LASIX 40MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor if you experience any unusual symptoms such as massive diuresis resulting in dehydration, volume depletion and electrolyte disturbances with consequent hypotension and cardiac toxicity. In high doses it may cause transient deafness and may precipitate gout (disturbed uric acid secretion).

faqs.question: Q: What is LASIX 40MG INJECTION and why is it prescribed?
faqs.answer: A: LASIX 40MG INJECTION contains frusemide (furosemide) which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to manage edema (fluid retention) due to problems with your heart, lungs, kidneys, liver, blood vessels or high blood pressure.

faqs.question: Q: Will LASIX 40MG INJECTION make me feel tired?
faqs.answer: A: LASIX 40MG INJECTION may cause hypotension (decrease in blood pressure) in some individuals and feeling of extreme tiredness or fainting can be attributed to this. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual symptoms after receiving LASIX 40MG INJECTION.

faqs.question: Q: Will LASIX 40MG INJECTION increase the urge to pass urine?
faqs.answer: A: No, although LASIX 40MG INJECTION acts by increasing urine output, it only increases the frequency of urine output and not the urge to pass urine. Consult your doctor if you experience any symptoms of urinary incontinence or if you have any bladder problems.

faqs.question: Q: Can LASIX 40MG INJECTION be used in pregnant women?
faqs.answer: A: LASIX 40MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly advised by the doctor. If it is administered in case of swelling or water retention, the growth of the baby must be regularly monitored. Consult your doctor before receiving LASIX 40MG INJECTION.

faqs.answer: A: LASIX 40MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or nurse into the vein (intravenously) or muscle (intramuscularly). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of LASIX 40MG INJECTION for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
