introduction:
Introduction About DIURIX SR 1.5MG TABLET

DIURIX SR 1.5MG TABLET contains Indapamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Thiazide like diuretics. It is used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension). It can also be used alone or in combination with other medicines to manage high blood pressure (hypertension) in adults.

Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel wall is too high, resulting in early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, changes in vision, and buzzing in the ears.

Your doctor may advise to have a test to check how well your parathyroid gland is working and blood tests to check for low sodium or potassium levels or high calcium levels before taking DIURIX SR 1.5MG TABLET.

DIURIX SR 1.5MG TABLET should be avoided in patients with severe liver disease or conditions like hepatic encephalopathy (liver problems affect your brain and central nervous system), severe kidney disease and low level of potassium in blood.

Before taking DIURIX SR 1.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have heart rhythm problems, diabetes, gout, muscle disorders, eye pain or decrease in vision due to choroidal effusion (fluid collection in the vascular layer of the eye) or earlier penicillin or sulphonamide allergy and are an athlete.

DIURIX SR 1.5MG TABLET is not recommended among pregnant and breastfeeding women. DIURIX SR 1.5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and need to be used with caution among elderly patients with impaired kidney function.

The most common side effect of taking DIURIX SR 1.5MG TABLET is skin rashes. Contact your doctor if the side effects gets worsen.

name: PLANEP T 10 Kit 20's
introduction:
Introduction About PLANEP T 10 KIT

PLANEP T 10 MG KIT is used in adults to manage high blood pressure and edema (swelling due to fluid retention) related to heart failure. It is a combination of Eplerenone and Torsemide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Hypertension is defined as persistently increased blood pressure that can show symptoms like headaches, sweating, a fast heartbeat, or a throbbing sensation. Fluid regularly drains into body tissues from the blood. When this fluid isn’t removed from the tissue, fluid retention (edema) occurs, causing symptoms like swelling and aching of affected body parts such as feet, ankles, or hands.

During the course of the management, your doctor might regularly monitor your kidney or liver function tests to avoid any untoward side effects.

Before taking PLANEP T 10 MG KIT, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, heart, or liver problems, high or low blood potassium levels, diabetes, low blood volume, or difficulty passing urine.

PLANEP T 10 MG KIT is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents due to its lack of safety and effectiveness.

The most common side effects of taking PLANEP T 10 MG KIT are muscle cramps, diarrhea, nausea, dizziness, headaches, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How PLANEP T 10 KIT Works

PLANEP T 10 MG KIT lowers edema where eplerenone blocks aldosterone, which is a mineralocorticoid acting on epithelial (e.g., kidney) and nonepithelial (e.g., heart and blood vessels) receptors to cause sodium and water reabsorption, and torsemide induces excretion of sodium, chloride, and water by inhibiting sodium and chloride reabsorption in kidney tubules.

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of PLANEP T 10 KIT, contact your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Introduction About TORADIC 100MG TABLET

TORADIC 100MG TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking TORADIC 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of TORADIC 100MG TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking TORADIC 100MG TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.

introduction:
Introduction About ALDACTONE T 10 TABLET

ALDACTONE T 10 TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking ALDACTONE T 10 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ALDACTONE T 10 TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking ALDACTONE T 10 TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. ALDACTONE T 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

ALDACTONE T 10 TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

Additionally, spironolactone can manage the loss of potassium via urine and can block the release of certain chemicals in the kidneys (aldosterone) that causes endocrine problems.

introduction:
Introduction About EMBETA HT 50MG TABLET

EMBETA HT 50MG TABLET is a combination of Hydrochlorothiazide and Metoprolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina) and uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking EMBETA HT 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions or gout as a precaution.

EMBETA HT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How EMBETA HT 50MG TABLET Works

EMBETA HT 50MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines namely, metoprolol and hydrochlorothiazide. Metoprolol works by blocking the actions of certain chemical messengers (such as adrenaline) in the body that increases heart rate and blood pressure.

Hydrochlorothiazide works by reducing the thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. It also helps in improving blood supply across all parts of the body. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump more blood with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use EMBETA HT 50MG TABLET

Take EMBETA HT 50MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. EMBETA HT 50MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

Have metabolic acidosis (too much acidity in blood)
Have unmanageed phaeochromocytoma (tumor present in adrenal glands)

Have thyrotoxicosis (increased thyroid hormones in the body)
Are severely dehydrated
Have low sodium, potassium, or magnesium levels in the blood
Are going to undergo an operation
Have gout
Have psoriasis (white scaly patches on the skin)

name: JBTOR 40 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About JBTOR 40 TABLET

JBTOR 40 TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking JBTOR 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of JBTOR 40 TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking JBTOR 40 TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.
uses: Oedema associated with congestive heart failure, kidney, or liver disease
Essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:
Uses Of JBTOR 40 TABLET

It is used to manage:

Oedema associated with congestive heart failure, kidney, or liver disease
Essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How JBTOR 40 TABLET Works

JBTOR 40 TABLET inhibits reabsorption of sodium and chloride in kidney by increasing urinary excretion of sodium, chloride, and water.  Thus, removing excessive fluid from the body.
usageInstructions: Take JBTOR 40 TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water.
Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
Do not stop taking JBTOR 40 TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

sideEffects: Disturbances in the amount of body water and minerals
Increased blood concentrations of uric acid, sugar and fats
Reduced potassium and sodium levels in blood
Increase of certain liver enzyme levels (gamma-GT)
Creeping sensation or tingling in arms and legs
Electrolyte and volume depletion (headache, dizziness, low blood pressure, weakness, drowsiness, confusion, loss of appetite, cramps)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of JBTOR 40 TABLET

Like all medicines, JBTOR 40 TABLET may cause side effects in few individuals, although not everybody gets them

Common Side Effects of JBTOR 40 TABLET:
Muscle cramps
Excessive alkaline in the body
Headache, Dizziness
Tiredness, weakness
Disturbances in the amount of body water and minerals
Increased blood concentrations of uric acid, sugar and fats
Reduced potassium and sodium levels in blood
Reduced blood volume
Loss of appetite
Stomach pain
Nausea, vomiting
Diarrhea
Constipation
Increase of certain liver enzyme levels (gamma-GT)
Creeping sensation or tingling in arms and legs

Stop taking JBTOR 40 TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Tinnitus (ringing in ears), hearing loss
Electrolyte and volume depletion (headache, dizziness, low blood pressure, weakness, drowsiness, confusion, loss of appetite, cramps)
Low blood pressure
Worsening of kidney function

warnings.details: Safety and effectiveness of JBTOR 40 TABLET in pregnant women or women planning to get pregnant has not been established yet. Hence it should be used during pregnancy only if clearly needed.

Safety and effectiveness of JBTOR 40 TABLET in breastfeeding women has not been established yet as it is not known if the medicine is excreted in the breastmilk. Hence it should be used with caution when administered to a nursing woman.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after taking JBTOR 40 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking JBTOR 40 TABLET because it might make you feel dizzy or drowsy.

JBTOR 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in anuric patients (kidneys fail to produce urine). JBTOR 40 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with kidney failure, and severe urinary flow disorders. The dose will be adjusted by your doctor.
JBTOR 40 TABLET is not recommended for patients with hepatic coma or pre-coma. JBTOR 40 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver diseases like cirrhosis and ascites.
Do not take JBTOR 40 TABLET if you are allergic to Torsemide or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
JBTOR 40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart failure.
JBTOR 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children as safety data has not been established yet.
There is no information on dosage adjustments in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking JBTOR 40 TABLET.

Others

JBTOR 40 TABLET is not recommended if you have:

Low volume of blood (hypovolaemia)
Low blood pressure (hypotension)

introduction:
Introduction About TORSINOL 20 TABLET

TORSINOL 20 TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Before taking TORSINOL 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of TORSINOL 20 TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking TORSINOL 20 TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.
uses: Oedema associated with congestive heart failure, kidney, or liver disease
Essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TORSINOL 20 TABLET

It is used to manage:

Oedema associated with congestive heart failure, kidney, or liver disease
Essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How TORSINOL 20 TABLET Works

TORSINOL 20 TABLET inhibits reabsorption of sodium and chloride in kidney by increasing urinary excretion of sodium, chloride, and water.  Thus, removing excessive fluid from the body.
usageInstructions: Take TORSINOL 20 TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water.
Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
Do not stop taking TORSINOL 20 TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

name: EPTUS T 20 Kit 1's
introduction:
Introduction About EPTUS T 20 KIT

EPTUS T 20 KIT is a combination of Eplerenone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used in adults to manage high blood pressure and edema (swelling due to fluid retention) related to heart failure.

Hypertension is defined as persistently increased blood pressure, that can show symptoms like headache, sweating, fast heartbeat or throbbing sensation. Fluid regularly drains into body tissues from the blood. When this fluid isn’t removed from the tissue, fluid retention (edema) occurs, causing symptoms like swelling and aching of affected body parts such as feet, ankles or hands.

During course of the management your doctor might regularly monitor your kidney or liver function test to avoid any untoward side effects.

Before taking EPTUS T 20 KIT, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, heart or liver problems, high or low blood potassium levels, diabetes, low blood volume or difficulty in passing urine.

EPTUS T 20 KIT is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents due to lack of safety and effectiveness.

The most common side effects of taking EPTUS T 20 KIT are muscle cramps, diarrhoea, nausea, dizziness, headache and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Manage high blood pressure and edema related to heart failure
usesDetails:
Uses Of EPTUS T 20 KIT
Manage high blood pressure and edema related to heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How EPTUS T 20 KIT Works

EPTUS T 20 KIT lowers edema where eplerenone blocks aldosterone, which is a mineralocorticoid acting on epithelial (e.g., kidney) and nonepithelial (e.g., heart and blood vessels) receptors to cause sodium and water reabsorption, and torsemide induces excretion of sodium, chloride and water by inhibiting sodium and chloride reabsorption in kidney tubules.
usageDetails:
How to use EPTUS T 20 KIT

Take EPTUS T 20 KIT as advised by your physician. Swallow EPTUS T 20 KIT with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking EPTUS T 20 KIT unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About TORZEST FORTE TABLET

TORZEST FORTE TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking TORZEST FORTE TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORZEST FORTE TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking TORZEST FORTE TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. TORZEST FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

TORZEST FORTE TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TORZEST FORTE TABLET Works

TORZEST FORTE TABLET contains two medicines namely spironolactone and torsemide. Both spironolactone and torsemide acts by removing the excess water and electrolytes (sodium and chloride) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing blood pressure. Additionally, spironolactone can manage the loss of potassium via urine and can block the release of certain chemicals in the kidneys (aldosterone) that causes endocrine problems.
usageDetails:
How to use TORZEST FORTE TABLET

Take TORZEST FORTE TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TORZEST FORTE TABLET unless your doctor tells you to stop.

Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness, drowsiness, or blurred vision after taking TORZEST FORTE TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORZEST FORTE TABLET as it might make you feel dizzy or faint even when you change posture.

TORZEST FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with moderate to severe kidney diseases (such as difficulty in passing urine or acute renal failure). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TORZEST FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart diseases (such as low blood pressure or abnormal heart rate). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

TORZEST FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have high levels of potassium in your blood (hyperkalaemia)
Have Addison’s disease (deficiency of cortisol and aldosterone)

Use in paediatrics:

There is no proper information regarding the use of TORZEST FORTE TABLET in children and adolescents (below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

TORZEST FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About DYTOR E 20MG COMBI KIT

DYTOR E 20MG COMBI KIT is a combination of Eplerenone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used in adults to manage high blood pressure and edema (swelling due to fluid retention) related to heart failure.

Hypertension is defined as persistently increased blood pressure, that can show symptoms like headache, sweating, fast heartbeat or throbbing sensation. Fluid regularly drains into body tissues from the blood. When this fluid isn’t removed from the tissue, fluid retention (edema) occurs, causing symptoms like swelling and aching of affected body parts such as feet, ankles or hands.

During course of the management your doctor might regularly monitor your kidney or liver function test to avoid any untoward side effects.

Before taking DYTOR E 20MG COMBI KIT, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, heart or liver problems, high or low blood potassium levels, diabetes, low blood volume or difficulty in passing urine.

DYTOR E 20MG COMBI KIT is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents due to lack of safety and effectiveness.

The most common side effects of taking DYTOR E 20MG COMBI KIT are muscle cramps, diarrhoea, nausea, dizziness, headache and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET

DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET Works

DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET contains two medicines namely spironolactone and torsemide. Both spironolactone and torsemide acts by removing the excess water and electrolytes (sodium and chloride) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing blood pressure. Additionally, spironolactone can manage the loss of potassium via urine and can block the release of certain chemicals in the kidneys (aldosterone) that causes endocrine problems.
usageDetails:
How to use DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET

Take DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET unless your doctor tells you to stop.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET as it might make you feel dizzy or faint even when you change posture.

DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with moderate to severe kidney diseases (such as difficulty in passing urine or acute renal failure). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients liver diseases. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart diseases (such as low blood pressure or abnormal heart rate). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have high levels of potassium in your blood (hyperkalaemia)
Have Addison’s disease (deficiency of cortisol and aldosterone)

Use in paediatrics:

There is no proper information regarding the use of DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET in children and adolescents (below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

DYAMIDE PLUS 50/10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About SEMITOR 10 TABLET

SEMITOR 10 TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking SEMITOR 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of SEMITOR 10 TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking SEMITOR 10 TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.

HYDRAZIDE 12.5MG TABLET contains Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It can also be used in the management of hypertension (high blood pressure) either alone or in combination with other medications.

During management with HYDRAZIDE 12.5MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking HYDRAZIDE 12.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, diabetes, low blood potassium levels, gout or electrolyte imbalance as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking HYDRAZIDE 12.5MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking HYDRAZIDE 12.5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, constipation, muscle spasm, blurred vision and impotence. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

name: JBTOR PLUS LS Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET

JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET Works

JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET contains two medicines namely spironolactone and torsemide. Both spironolactone and torsemide acts by removing the excess water and electrolytes (sodium and chloride) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing blood pressure. Additionally, spironolactone can manage the loss of potassium via urine and can block the release of certain chemicals in the kidneys (aldosterone) that causes endocrine problems.
usageDetails:
How to use JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET

Take JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET unless your doctor tells you to stop.

Others

JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have high levels of potassium in your blood (hyperkalaemia)
Have Addison’s disease (deficiency of cortisol and aldosterone)

There is no proper information regarding the use of JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET in children and adolescents (below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

JBTOR PLUS LS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About TORMAX 20 TABLET

TORMAX 20 TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking TORMAX 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of TORMAX 20 TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking TORMAX 20 TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.

Manage oedema (fluid accumulation in the body parts which causes swelling)
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How HYDRAZIDE 25MG TABLET Works

HYDRAZIDE 25MG TABLET is a diuretic. It acts by removing excess water from the body in the form of urine. This reduces swelling of body parts and manages fluid accumulation. It also reduces the thickness of blood which reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use HYDRAZIDE 25MG TABLET

Take HYDRAZIDE 25MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take HYDRAZIDE 25MG TABLET at the same time each day.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take HYDRAZIDE 25MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET

FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET contains frusemide (furosemide) which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to manage edema (fluid retention) due to problems with your heart, lungs, kidneys, liver, blood vessels or high blood pressure. Generally, accumulation of excess fluid in the body adds extra pressure on your heart, blood vessels, lungs, kidneys or liver and can cause swelling of the ankles, breathing difficulties or even make you feel more tired than usual.

During the course of management with FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET, your doctor will recommend you take several blood tests to monitor your blood sugar and uric acid levels as a precaution to avoid unwanted side effects. They may also monitor your blood potassium and sodium levels carefully, especially if you have vomiting or diarrhea.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver or heart problems. FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in children over 12 years of age. Also, it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET are dehydration, electrolyte imbalance and decreased blood volume. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens or persist for a long period of time.
uses: Manage edema (fluid retention)
usesDetails:
Uses Of FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET
Manage edema (fluid retention)
mechanismOfAction:
How FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET Works

FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET contains frusemide which is a loop diuretic. It works by inhibiting the reabsorption of sodium and chloride in the proximal and distal tubules and in the thick ascending loop of Henle by inhibiting the sodium-chloride cotransport system. As a result, it promotes diuresis (urine output) by enhancing the excretion of water along with sodium, chloride, magnesium and calcium.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET, as long as your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having anuria (failure of the kidneys to produce urine), severe kidney damage, kidney failure or impaired kidney function due to poisoning by nephrotoxic agents. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET.

FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver cirrhosis and liver encephalopathy. It should be used with caution in patients with liver congestion (slowed blood flow through the vessels) or other liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET.
Do not take FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET if you are allergic to frusemide (furosemide) or sulphonamide antibiotics (such as sulfamethoxazole).
FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET.
FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in children over 12 years of age. A suitable dosage form is used in children under 12 years of age. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET.

Others

FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are dehydrated
Have low levels of sodium, potassium or other electrolytes in the blood
Have low blood volume
Have addison’s disease
Have digitalis poisoning

Before taking FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have hypovolaemia (low blood volume)
Have hypoproteinemia (low levels of proteins in blood) due to kidney damage
Have prostate trouble or difficulty in passing urine
Have diabetes
Have gout (painful or inflamed joints)
Have an abnormal blood condition
Are going to undergo any blood or urine test

Before taking FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to reduce high blood pressure such as ACE inhibitors (Ex. ramipril, enalapril, perindopril), angiotensin II-receptor blockers (Ex. losartan, candesartan, irbesartan), alpha-blockers (Ex. prazosin), thiazide diuretics (Ex. bendroflumethiazide) and potassium sparging diuretics (Ex. amiloride, spironolactone, acetazolamide and metolazone)
Medicines used to manage irregular heartbeat (Ex. digoxin, amiodarone, sotalol, disopyramide, flecainide, lidocaine, mexiletine dofetilide and ibutilide)
Medicines used to manage angina (Ex. nitroglycerin or isosorbide dinitrate)
Medicines used to reduce high cholesterol levels in blood (Ex. clofibrate, colestyramine and colestipol)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. insulin and metformin)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen, ketoprofen or indomethacin)
Corticosteroids (used to manage pain or inflammation) Ex. dexamethasone, prednisolone
Medicines used to manage stomach ulcers (Ex. sucralfate or carbenoxolone)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine or phenobarbital)
Antibiotics (used to manage bacterial infections) such as gentamicin, amikacin, neomycin, netilmicin, tobramycin, vancomycin or cephalosporins such as cefixime
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. terbutaline, salbutamol, salmeterol, formoterol or bambuterol)
Medicines used to manage nasal congestion (Ex. xylometazoline or ephedrine)
Medicines used to manage mental problems (Ex. lithium, chlorpromazine, risperidone, amisulpride, sertindole or pimozide)

Laxatives (used to manage constipation) Ex. lactulose, polyethylene glycol, bisacodyl

Theophylline (a medicine used to manage breathing difficulties)

Probenecid (used to manage gout)
Cisplatin (used to manage certain type of cancers)
Methotrexate (used to manage severe arthritis or some forms of cancer)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET includes dehydration and changes in the levels of certain chemicals in the blood.

faqs.question: Q: What is FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET and why is it prescribed?
faqs.answer: A: FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET contains frusemide (furosemide) which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to manage edema (fluid retention) due to problems with your heart, lungs, kidneys, liver, blood vessels or high blood pressure.

faqs.question: Q: Will FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET make me feel tired?
faqs.answer: A: FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET may cause hypotension (decrease in blood pressure) in some individuals and feeling of extreme tiredness or fainting can be attributed to this. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual symptoms after taking FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET.

faqs.question: Q: Is FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET safe to use in patients with kidney problems?

faqs.question: Q: Will FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET increase the urge to pass urine?
faqs.answer: A: No, although FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET acts by increasing urine output, it only increases the frequency of urine output and not the urge to pass urine. Consult your doctor if you experience any symptoms of urinary incontinence or if you have any bladder problems.

faqs.question: Q: Can FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET be used in pregnant women?
faqs.answer: A: FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you become pregnant while taking FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET talk to your doctor to check the growth of the baby. Consult your doctor before taking FRUSENEX 100MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About MELTOR 40MG TABLET

MELTOR 40MG TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking MELTOR 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of MELTOR 40MG TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking MELTOR 40MG TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.

introduction:
Introduction About DIURIX 2.5MG TABLET

DIURIX 2.5MG TABLET contains Indapamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Thiazide like diuretics. It is used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension). It can also be used alone or in combination with other medicines to manage high blood pressure (hypertension) in adults.

Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel wall is too high, resulting in early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, changes in vision, and buzzing in the ears.

Your doctor may advise to have a test to check how well your parathyroid gland is working and blood tests to check for low sodium or potassium levels or high calcium levels before taking DIURIX 2.5MG TABLET.

DIURIX 2.5MG TABLET should be avoided in patients with severe liver disease or conditions like hepatic encephalopathy (liver problems affect your brain and central nervous system), severe kidney disease and low level of potassium in blood.

Before taking DIURIX 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have heart rhythm problems, diabetes, gout, muscle disorders, eye pain or decrease in vision due to choroidal effusion (fluid collection in the vascular layer of the eye) or earlier penicillin or sulphonamide allergy and are an athlete.

DIURIX 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended among pregnant and breastfeeding women. DIURIX 2.5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and need to be used with caution among elderly patients with impaired kidney function.

The most common side effect of taking DIURIX 2.5MG TABLET is skin rashes. Contact your doctor if the side effects gets worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DIURIX 2.5MG TABLET Works

DIURIX 2.5MG TABLET lowers blood pressure by removing the extra water and salt from the body through acting on kidney. It also widens the blood vessel and makes the blood flow easy through blood vessels. This combined effect lowers blood pressure more effectively.

Take DIURIX 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DIURIX 2.5MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About TORPRES PLUS 10 TABLET

TORPRES PLUS 10 TABLET contains a combination of Torsemide, a loop diuretic, and Spironolactone, a potassium-sparing diuretic. This effective combination is used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and edema associated with heart conditions.

TORPRES PLUS 10 TABLET is recommended to take in the morning with food in order to avoid frequent urination at night time. For optimal results, it is advised to take it at the same time each day. The dosage and frequency depend on the condition being managed, and your doctor will determine the appropriate amount to improve your symptoms. Continue taking the medication for as long as it is prescribed by your doctor.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, low blood pressure, dehydration, changes in potassium levels. If you experience any severe symptoms, seek medical advice immediately. Dehydration is very common side effect of this medicine. It might lower down the level of calcium, sodium, and magnesium in the blood. Hence, regular monitoring of kidney function and electrolytes is important while taking this medicine. It might cause dizziness or tiredness, if happens rise slowly from sitting position or avoid driving.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. Also, let your doctor know if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women. Additionally, make sure to share all other medications you are currently taking, as they could interact with or be affected by this medicine.

- Fresh fruits

Hydration

- Beans (black beans, kidney beans)




High-Fiber Foods

	

Fiber helps with digestion and maintaining healthy blood pressure levels.

	

- Oats
- Whole grains
- Vegetables (broccoli, carrots)
- Legumes (lentils, chickpeas)




Healthy Fats

	

Include healthy fats to support overall cardiovascular health.

	

- Olive oil
- Nuts (almonds, walnuts)
- Fatty fish (salmon, mackerel)




Lean Proteins

	

Include sources of lean proteins for muscle health and blood pressure regulation.

	

- Chicken breast
- Fish
- Tofu
- Eggs (in moderation)




Limit Processed Foods

	

Avoid processed and packaged foods as they can be high in sodium and unhealthy fats.

	

- Avoid canned soups, frozen meals, packaged snacks, and fast food.




Calcium-Rich Foods

	

Support bone health with calcium-rich foods to balance electrolytes.

	

- Low-fat dairy (milk, yogurt)
- Leafy greens (kale, collard greens)
- Almonds

02. How can staying active and managing fluid intake enhance the effects of TORPRES PLUS 10 TABLET? What are some general lifestyle recommendations to promote heart health and overall well-being?

Aspect

	

Explanation

	

Lifestyle Tips




Staying Active

	

Physical activity can enhance circulation, improve heart function, and help in managing blood pressure. It works synergistically with TORPRES PLUS 10 TABLET, which helps reduce fluid retention.

	

1. Engage in at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (e.g., walking, cycling) most days of the week.


 	

It can also support weight management, which is crucial for overall cardiovascular health.

	

2. Incorporate strength training exercises twice a week to improve muscle tone and metabolism.


 	 	

3. Avoid prolonged periods of inactivity; take short walks throughout the day.




Managing Fluid Intake

	

TORPRES PLUS 10 TABLET helps remove excess fluid by increasing urination, but proper fluid management is still important. Too much fluid intake can counteract its effects.

	

1. Maintain hydration with water, but avoid excessive fluid intake to prevent overloading kidneys.


 	

Consuming the right amount of fluids helps prevent dehydration, which can worsen heart problems.

	

2. Limit caffeine and alcohol, as they can lead to dehydration and exacerbate fluid retention.


 	 	

3. Monitor your daily fluid intake to ensure it aligns with your doctor's recommendations.




Dietary Considerations

	

A balanced diet supports heart health and works in conjunction with TORPRES PLUS 10 TABLET. Reducing sodium and eating nutrient-dense foods can enhance fluid management and overall wellness.

	

1. Follow a heart-healthy diet (e.g., DASH or Mediterranean diet). Focus on fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins.


 	 	

2. Limit high-sodium foods to help prevent fluid retention.


 	 	

3. Include potassium-rich foods (bananas, spinach, potatoes) to help balance sodium levels.




Monitoring Weight & Blood Pressure

	

Regular monitoring of weight and blood pressure helps assess the effectiveness of TORPRES PLUS 10 TABLET in managing fluid retention and preventing complications.

	

1. Weigh yourself regularly and track changes to notice any sudden weight gain, which may indicate fluid buildup.


 	 	

2. Keep track of your blood pressure regularly to ensure it's within the target range.




Stress Management

	

Chronic stress can negatively impact heart health and fluid balance. Managing stress complements the benefits of TORPRES PLUS 10 TABLET

	

1. Practice relaxation techniques like deep breathing, meditation, or yoga.


 	 	

2. Ensure you are getting enough sleep (7-9 hours per night) to help manage stress and support overall health.




Avoiding Overexertion

	

Overexertion can strain the heart, especially when dealing with fluid imbalances.

	

1. Avoid intense physical activities that can lead to fatigue or excessive fluid loss.


 	 	

2. Listen to your body and adjust exercise intensity based on how you are feeling.

Alternative Medication

	

Class

	

Indication

	

Mechanism of Action

	

Key Considerations

Loop Diuretic

Commonly prescribed, requires monitoring of electrolytes

Potassium-Sparing Diuretic

	

Edema, heart failure, ascites, hyperaldosteronism

	

Antagonizes aldosterone in the kidneys to reduce sodium retention

	

Can cause hyperkalemia, monitor potassium levels

Edema, heart failure

	

Similar to furosemide, inhibits sodium and chloride reabsorption in the loop of Henle

	

May cause electrolyte imbalances

Hypertension, heart failure, edema

	

Inhibits sodium channels in the distal nephron, reducing sodium reabsorption

	

Can cause hyperkalemia, less effective than other diuretics for fluid removal

04. Are there natural alternatives or home remedies that can help manage hypertension instead of using prescription medications like TORPRES PLUS 10 TABLET?

Natural Alternative

	

Description

	

Evidence/Effectiveness

	

Usage/Recommendations




Garlic

	

Garlic is thought to help lower blood pressure by improving blood vessel dilation.

	

Some studies show garlic can lower blood pressure slightly, especially when consumed regularly.

	

1-2 cloves per day, or as garlic supplements.




Hibiscus Tea

	

Hibiscus contains compounds that may help lower blood pressure by acting as a diuretic.

	

Research suggests it can lower systolic and diastolic blood pressure in people with mild hypertension.

	

1-2 cups daily of brewed hibiscus tea.




Magnesium

	

Magnesium helps regulate blood pressure and supports cardiovascular health.

	

Some studies show that magnesium supplementation may help reduce blood pressure in people with deficiencies.

	

200-400 mg/day, ideally from food sources (e.g., leafy greens, nuts).




Beetroot Juice

	

Beetroot contains nitrates, which can help dilate blood vessels and reduce blood pressure.

	

Clinical studies support the idea that beetroot juice can lower both systolic and diastolic pressure.

	

1 glass (250-500 mL) per day.




Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10)

	

CoQ10 is an antioxidant that may help improve vascular function and reduce BP.

	

Some evidence indicates that CoQ10 supplementation can significantly lower blood pressure in hypertensive individuals.

	

100-200 mg/day.




Omega-3 Fatty Acids (Fish Oil)

	

Omega-3s found in fatty fish may help reduce blood pressure by improving heart health.

	

Studies suggest that omega-3 fatty acids can lower blood pressure, particularly in those with high blood pressure.

	

1,000-3,000 mg of EPA and DHA per day (from fish or supplements).




Celery Seed Extract

	

Celery seeds have compounds that may help relax blood vessels and lower BP.

	

Some research supports its use as a mild blood pressure-lowering agent.

	

75-150 mg of celery seed extract per day.




Lemon

	

Lemons may help lower blood pressure by acting as a natural diuretic and improving circulation.

	

Some evidence suggests that lemon or lemon juice may lower BP, especially when used regularly.

	

1/2 to 1 whole lemon per day, consumed in water or tea.




Exercise

	

Regular physical activity can reduce blood pressure by improving heart and vascular health.

	

Numerous studies show that aerobic exercise and resistance training can lower blood pressure over time.

	

At least 30 minutes of moderate activity most days of the week.




Potassium-Rich Foods

	

Potassium helps balance sodium levels in the body and supports heart health.

	

A high-potassium diet is associated with lower blood pressure.

	

Aim for 3,500-4,700 mg of potassium per day, through food like bananas, spinach, and sweet potatoes.




Mindfulness & Stress Reduction

	

Practices like meditation, deep breathing, and yoga can lower stress and BP.

	

Reducing stress has been shown to significantly impact blood pressure management.

	

10-30 minutes of meditation or yoga daily.

introduction:
Introduction About TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET

TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET Works

TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET contains two medicines namely spironolactone and torsemide. Both spironolactone and torsemide acts by removing the excess water and electrolytes (sodium and chloride) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing blood pressure. Additionally, spironolactone can manage the loss of potassium via urine and can block the release of certain chemicals in the kidneys (aldosterone) that causes endocrine problems.
usageDetails:
How to use TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET

Take TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET unless your doctor tells you to stop.

warnings.details: TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness, drowsiness, or blurred vision after taking TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET as it might make you feel dizzy or faint even when you change posture.

TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with moderate to severe kidney diseases (such as difficulty in passing urine or acute renal failure). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients liver diseases. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET if you are allergic to Torsemide, Spironolactone or sulfonylureas (Ex. glimepiride, glipizide).
TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart diseases (such as low blood pressure or abnormal heart rate). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have high levels of potassium in your blood (hyperkalaemia)
Have Addison’s disease (deficiency of cortisol and aldosterone)

Use in paediatrics:

There is no proper information regarding the use of TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET in children and adolescents (below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Cholestyramine (a medicine used to control blood cholesterol levels)
Medicines that exert effects on heart function during emergency conditions (Ex. adrenaline, noradrenaline)

Lithium (a medicine used to manage mental illness)
Medicines used to reduce anxiety and to induce sleep (Ex. phenobarbital) 
Corticosteroids (used to manage inflammation) Ex. methylprednisolone
Adrenocorticotropic hormone (used to manage cortisol deficiency)
Medicines used to relax muscles (Ex. tubocurarine)
Medicines used for pain relief (Ex. indomethacin, aspirin, morphine, fentanyl, codeine)
Cardiac glycosides (used to manage cardiac failure) Ex. digoxin
Carbenoxolone (a medicine used to manage ulcers)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections Ex. trimethoprim, sulfamethoxazole, ceftriaxone, cefazolin, gentamycin, streptomycin

Heparin and low molecular weight heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Potassium supplements (used to manage potassium deficiency) Ex. potassium chloride
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure such as ACE inhibitors, angiotensin II blockers or beta-blockers (Ex. enalapril, telmisartan, valsartan, propranolol)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. metformin, glimepiride)

B. Drug-Food interactions

Avoid foods rich in potassium such as bananas, dry fruits, lentils, dairy products, and salt substitutes such as potassium chloride.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more TORSIVAC PLUS TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose might include dehydration,
low blood pressure, decreased body fluids and electrolytes levels, low blood sodium levels, abnormal blood potassium levels, increased RBC count, drowsiness, mental confusion, erythematous rash, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, diarrhoea, or liver problems.

introduction:
Introduction About INMIDE SR 1.5MG TABLET

INMIDE SR 1.5MG TABLET contains Indapamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Thiazide like diuretics. It is used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension). It can also be used alone or in combination with other medicines to manage high blood pressure (hypertension) in adults.

Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel wall is too high, resulting in early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, changes in vision, and buzzing in the ears.

Your doctor may advise to have a test to check how well your parathyroid gland is working and blood tests to check for low sodium or potassium levels or high calcium levels before taking INMIDE SR 1.5MG TABLET.

INMIDE SR 1.5MG TABLET should be avoided in patients with severe liver disease or conditions like hepatic encephalopathy (liver problems affect your brain and central nervous system), severe kidney disease and low level of potassium in blood.

Before taking INMIDE SR 1.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have heart rhythm problems, diabetes, gout, muscle disorders, eye pain or decrease in vision due to choroidal effusion (fluid collection in the vascular layer of the eye) or earlier penicillin or sulphonamide allergy and are an athlete.

INMIDE SR 1.5MG TABLET is not recommended among pregnant and breastfeeding women. INMIDE SR 1.5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and need to be used with caution among elderly patients with impaired kidney function.

The most common side effect of taking INMIDE SR 1.5MG TABLET is skin rashes. Contact your doctor if the side effects gets worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NEPHTOR 40MG TABLET

NEPHTOR 40MG TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking NEPHTOR 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of NEPHTOR 40MG TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking NEPHTOR 40MG TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.
uses: Oedema associated with congestive heart failure, kidney, or liver disease
Essential hypertension (high blood pressure)

How NEPHTOR 40MG TABLET Works

NEPHTOR 40MG TABLET inhibits reabsorption of sodium and chloride in kidney by increasing urinary excretion of sodium, chloride, and water.  Thus, removing excessive fluid from the body.

Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Do not stop taking NEPHTOR 40MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after taking NEPHTOR 40MG TABLET.

Low volume of blood (hypovolaemia)
Low blood pressure (hypotension)

introduction:
Introduction About SEMITOR PLUS 20 TABLET

SEMITOR PLUS 20 TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking SEMITOR PLUS 20 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking SEMITOR PLUS 20 TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking SEMITOR PLUS 20 TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. SEMITOR PLUS 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

SEMITOR PLUS 20 TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

Additionally, spironolactone can manage the loss of potassium via urine and can block the release of certain chemicals in the kidneys (aldosterone) that causes endocrine problems.

introduction:
Introduction About TORSECHEM 10 TABLET

TORSECHEM 10 TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking TORSECHEM 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of TORSECHEM 10 TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking TORSECHEM 10 TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.

How TORSECHEM 10 TABLET Works

TORSECHEM 10 TABLET inhibits reabsorption of sodium and chloride in kidney by increasing urinary excretion of sodium, chloride, and water.  Thus, removing excessive fluid from the body.

Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Do not stop taking TORSECHEM 10 TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About DYTOR PLUS LS 20 TABLET

DYTOR PLUS LS 20 TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking DYTOR PLUS LS 20 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DYTOR PLUS LS 20 TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking DYTOR PLUS LS 20 TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. DYTOR PLUS LS 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

DYTOR PLUS LS 20 TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

Additionally, spironolactone can manage the loss of potassium via urine and can block the release of certain chemicals in the kidneys (aldosterone) that causes endocrine problems.

introduction:
Introduction About SEMITOR 20 TABLET

SEMITOR 20 TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking SEMITOR 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of SEMITOR 20 TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking SEMITOR 20 TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.

mechanismOfAction:
How SEMITOR 20 TABLET Works

SEMITOR 20 TABLET inhibits reabsorption of sodium and chloride in kidney by increasing urinary excretion of sodium, chloride, and water.  Thus, removing excessive fluid from the body.

Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
Do not stop taking SEMITOR 20 TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About TORUTIC PLUS TABLET

TORUTIC PLUS TABLET contains a combination of Torsemide, a loop diuretic, and Spironolactone, a potassium-sparing diuretic. This effective combination is used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and edema associated with heart conditions.

TORUTIC PLUS TABLET is recommended to take in the morning with food in order to avoid frequent urination at night time. For optimal results, it is advised to take it at the same time each day. The dosage and frequency depend on the condition being managed, and your doctor will determine the appropriate amount to improve your symptoms. Continue taking the medication for as long as it is prescribed by your doctor.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, low blood pressure, dehydration, changes in potassium levels. If you experience any severe symptoms, seek medical advice immediately. Dehydration is very common side effect of this medicine. It might lower down the level of calcium, sodium, and magnesium in the blood. Hence, regular monitoring of kidney function and electrolytes is important while taking this medicine. It might cause dizziness or tiredness, if happens rise slowly from sitting position or avoid driving.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. Also, let your doctor know if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women. Additionally, make sure to share all other medications you are currently taking, as they could interact with or be affected by this medicine.

01. Could you suggest a healthy diet that complements the use of TORUTIC PLUS TABLET, focusing on low-sodium meals, proper hydration, and potassium-rich foods (such as bananas and spinach)?

Dietary Focus

	

Recommended Foods/Actions

	

Examples




Low-Sodium Meals

	

Limit sodium intake to reduce water retention and blood pressure.

	

- Fresh vegetables
- Fresh fruits
- Lean proteins (chicken, turkey)
- Whole grains (brown rice, quinoa)




Hydration

	

Drink plenty of water throughout the day to stay hydrated and support kidney function.

	

- 8-10 glasses of water daily (depending on activity level)
- Herbal teas (no caffeine)




Potassium-Rich Foods

	

Include potassium-rich foods to balance sodium and help manage fluid levels in the body.

	

- Bananas
- Spinach
- Sweet potatoes
- Avocados
- Beans (black beans, kidney beans)




High-Fiber Foods

	

Fiber helps with digestion and maintaining healthy blood pressure levels.

	

- Oats
- Whole grains
- Vegetables (broccoli, carrots)
- Legumes (lentils, chickpeas)




Healthy Fats

	

Include healthy fats to support overall cardiovascular health.

	

- Olive oil
- Nuts (almonds, walnuts)
- Fatty fish (salmon, mackerel)




Lean Proteins

	

Include sources of lean proteins for muscle health and blood pressure regulation.

	

- Chicken breast
- Fish
- Tofu
- Eggs (in moderation)




Limit Processed Foods

	

Avoid processed and packaged foods as they can be high in sodium and unhealthy fats.

	

- Avoid canned soups, frozen meals, packaged snacks, and fast food.




Calcium-Rich Foods

	

Support bone health with calcium-rich foods to balance electrolytes.

	

- Low-fat dairy (milk, yogurt)
- Leafy greens (kale, collard greens)
- Almonds

02. How can staying active and managing fluid intake enhance the effects of TORUTIC PLUS TABLET? What are some general lifestyle recommendations to promote heart health and overall well-being?

Aspect

	

Explanation

	

Lifestyle Tips




Staying Active

	

Physical activity can enhance circulation, improve heart function, and help in managing blood pressure. It works synergistically with TORUTIC PLUS TABLET, which helps reduce fluid retention.

	

1. Engage in at least 30 minutes of moderate exercise (e.g., walking, cycling) most days of the week.


 	

It can also support weight management, which is crucial for overall cardiovascular health.

	

2. Incorporate strength training exercises twice a week to improve muscle tone and metabolism.


 	 	

3. Avoid prolonged periods of inactivity; take short walks throughout the day.




Managing Fluid Intake

	

TORUTIC PLUS TABLET helps remove excess fluid by increasing urination, but proper fluid management is still important. Too much fluid intake can counteract its effects.

	

1. Maintain hydration with water, but avoid excessive fluid intake to prevent overloading kidneys.


 	

Consuming the right amount of fluids helps prevent dehydration, which can worsen heart problems.

	

2. Limit caffeine and alcohol, as they can lead to dehydration and exacerbate fluid retention.


 	 	

3. Monitor your daily fluid intake to ensure it aligns with your doctor's recommendations.




Dietary Considerations

	

A balanced diet supports heart health and works in conjunction with TORUTIC PLUS TABLET. Reducing sodium and eating nutrient-dense foods can enhance fluid management and overall wellness.

	

1. Follow a heart-healthy diet (e.g., DASH or Mediterranean diet). Focus on fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins.


 	 	

2. Limit high-sodium foods to help prevent fluid retention.


 	 	

3. Include potassium-rich foods (bananas, spinach, potatoes) to help balance sodium levels.




Monitoring Weight & Blood Pressure

	

Regular monitoring of weight and blood pressure helps assess the effectiveness of TORUTIC PLUS TABLET in managing fluid retention and preventing complications.

	

1. Weigh yourself regularly and track changes to notice any sudden weight gain, which may indicate fluid buildup.


 	 	

2. Keep track of your blood pressure regularly to ensure it's within the target range.




Stress Management

	

Chronic stress can negatively impact heart health and fluid balance. Managing stress complements the benefits of TORUTIC PLUS TABLET

	

1. Practice relaxation techniques like deep breathing, meditation, or yoga.


 	 	

2. Ensure you are getting enough sleep (7-9 hours per night) to help manage stress and support overall health.




Avoiding Overexertion

	

Overexertion can strain the heart, especially when dealing with fluid imbalances.

	

1. Avoid intense physical activities that can lead to fatigue or excessive fluid loss.


 	 	

2. Listen to your body and adjust exercise intensity based on how you are feeling.

 

03. What are the alternative diuretics or medications for managing similar health conditions in patients who cannot use TORUTIC PLUS TABLET?

Alternative Medication

	

Class

	

Indication

	

Mechanism of Action

	

Key Considerations




Furosemide (Lasix)

	

Loop Diuretic

	

Edema, heart failure, kidney disease, hypertension

	

Inhibits sodium and chloride reabsorption in the loop of Henle

	

Commonly prescribed, requires monitoring of electrolytes




Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)

	

Thiazide Diuretic

	

Hypertension, edema due to heart failure, kidney disease

	

Increases sodium and water excretion in the distal tubule

	

Can cause hypokalemia and dehydration




Spironolactone (Aldactone)

	

Potassium-Sparing Diuretic

	

Edema, heart failure, ascites, hyperaldosteronism

	

Antagonizes aldosterone in the kidneys to reduce sodium retention

	

Can cause hyperkalemia, monitor potassium levels




Bumetanide (Bumex)

	

Loop Diuretic

	

Edema, heart failure

	

Similar to furosemide, inhibits sodium and chloride reabsorption in the loop of Henle

	

May cause electrolyte imbalances




Amiloride

	

Potassium-Sparing Diuretic

	

Hypertension, heart failure, edema

	

Inhibits sodium channels in the distal nephron, reducing sodium reabsorption

	

Can cause hyperkalemia, less effective than other diuretics for fluid removal




Torsemide (Demadex)

	

Loop Diuretic

	

Heart failure, edema, hypertension

	

Inhibits sodium and chloride reabsorption in the loop of Henle

	

Similar to furosemide, but has a longer half-life

Thiazide-like Diuretic

	

Hypertension, edema

Longer duration of action than HCTZ, risk of electrolyte disturbances




Eplerenone (Inspra)

Heart failure, post-MI, edema
