Fewer side effects than spironolactone, can cause hyperkalemia

 

04. Are there natural alternatives or home remedies that can help manage hypertension instead of using prescription medications like TORUTIC PLUS TABLET?

Natural Alternative

	

Description

	

Evidence/Effectiveness

	

Usage/Recommendations




Garlic

	

Garlic is thought to help lower blood pressure by improving blood vessel dilation.

	

Some studies show garlic can lower blood pressure slightly, especially when consumed regularly.

	

1-2 cloves per day, or as garlic supplements.




Hibiscus Tea

	

Hibiscus contains compounds that may help lower blood pressure by acting as a diuretic.

	

Research suggests it can lower systolic and diastolic blood pressure in people with mild hypertension.

	

1-2 cups daily of brewed hibiscus tea.




Magnesium

	

Magnesium helps regulate blood pressure and supports cardiovascular health.

	

Some studies show that magnesium supplementation may help reduce blood pressure in people with deficiencies.

	

200-400 mg/day, ideally from food sources (e.g., leafy greens, nuts).




Beetroot Juice

	

Beetroot contains nitrates, which can help dilate blood vessels and reduce blood pressure.

	

Clinical studies support the idea that beetroot juice can lower both systolic and diastolic pressure.

	

1 glass (250-500 mL) per day.




Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10)

	

CoQ10 is an antioxidant that may help improve vascular function and reduce BP.

	

Some evidence indicates that CoQ10 supplementation can significantly lower blood pressure in hypertensive individuals.

	

100-200 mg/day.




Omega-3 Fatty Acids (Fish Oil)

	

Omega-3s found in fatty fish may help reduce blood pressure by improving heart health.

	

Studies suggest that omega-3 fatty acids can lower blood pressure, particularly in those with high blood pressure.

	

1,000-3,000 mg of EPA and DHA per day (from fish or supplements).




Celery Seed Extract

	

Celery seeds have compounds that may help relax blood vessels and lower BP.

	

Some research supports its use as a mild blood pressure-lowering agent.

	

75-150 mg of celery seed extract per day.




Lemon

	

Lemons may help lower blood pressure by acting as a natural diuretic and improving circulation.

	

Some evidence suggests that lemon or lemon juice may lower BP, especially when used regularly.

	

1/2 to 1 whole lemon per day, consumed in water or tea.




Exercise

	

Regular physical activity can reduce blood pressure by improving heart and vascular health.

	

Numerous studies show that aerobic exercise and resistance training can lower blood pressure over time.

	

At least 30 minutes of moderate activity most days of the week.




Potassium-Rich Foods

	

Potassium helps balance sodium levels in the body and supports heart health.

	

A high-potassium diet is associated with lower blood pressure.

	

Aim for 3,500-4,700 mg of potassium per day, through food like bananas, spinach, and sweet potatoes.




Mindfulness & Stress Reduction

	

Practices like meditation, deep breathing, and yoga can lower stress and BP.

	

Reducing stress has been shown to significantly impact blood pressure management.

	

10-30 minutes of meditation or yoga daily.

introduction:
Introduction About VITATOR 20MG TABLET

VITATOR 20MG TABLET is indicated for the management of oedema associated with congestive heart failure, renal or hepatic disease and essential hypertension. It contains Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition. It is not recommended for use if you have anuria (failure of kidney to produce urine), hepatic coma (loss of brain function due to liver damage). Before taking VITATOR 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart failure. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine. Safety and effectiveness of VITATOR 20MG TABLET in pregnant or breastfeeding women has not been established yet, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking VITATOR 20MG TABLET are muscle cramps, loss of appetite, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation.
uses: Oedema associated with congestive heart failure, kidney, or liver disease
Essential hypertension (high blood pressure)

How VITATOR 20MG TABLET Works

Do not stop taking VITATOR 20MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

warnings.details: Safety and effectiveness of VITATOR 20MG TABLET in pregnant women or women planning to get pregnant has not been established yet. Hence it should be used during pregnancy only if clearly needed.

Safety and effectiveness of VITATOR 20MG TABLET in breastfeeding women has not been established yet as it is not known if the medicine is excreted in the breastmilk. Hence it should be used with caution when administered to a nursing woman.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after taking VITATOR 20MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking VITATOR 20MG TABLET because it might make you feel dizzy or drowsy.

VITATOR 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in anuric patients (kidneys fail to produce urine). VITATOR 20MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with kidney failure, and severe urinary flow disorders. The dose will be adjusted by your doctor.
VITATOR 20MG TABLET is not recommended for patients with hepatic coma or pre-coma. VITATOR 20MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver diseases like cirrhosis and ascites.
Do not take VITATOR 20MG TABLET if you are allergic to Torsemide or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
VITATOR 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart failure.
VITATOR 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children as safety data has not been established yet.
There is no information on dosage adjustments in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking VITATOR 20MG TABLET.

Others

VITATOR 20MG TABLET is not recommended if you have:

Low volume of blood (hypovolaemia)
Low blood pressure (hypotension)

name: TORZEST PLUS Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TORZEST PLUS TABLET

TORZEST PLUS TABLET is a fixed-dose combination of Spironolactone and Torsemide which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics. It is used to reduce fluid accumulation (oedema) in the body that is caused due to severe liver, kidney or heart problems. It can also be used to manage hyperaldosteronism (excessive secretion of aldosterone in the body) and resistant hypertension (high blood pressure that is not controlled by other medicines).

Before taking TORZEST PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORZEST PLUS TABLET as it may make you feel dizzy or faint even while changing posture.

Avoid consuming potassium rich diet or potassium supplements while taking TORZEST PLUS TABLET, as it may further increase the levels of potassium in your body. TORZEST PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

TORZEST PLUS TABLET may alters the levels of electrolytes in your body and may make you feel dizzy or tired very easily. To avoid this, your doctor would regularly monitor your serum electrolyte levels and may increase or decrease the dose of this medicine accordingly.

The most common side effects of [GBKEYWORD] are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, tiredness, increased urination and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TORZEST PLUS TABLET Works

TORZEST PLUS TABLET contains two medicines namely spironolactone and torsemide. Both spironolactone and torsemide acts by removing the excess water and electrolytes (sodium and chloride) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing blood pressure. Additionally, spironolactone can manage the loss of potassium via urine and can block the release of certain chemicals in the kidneys (aldosterone) that causes endocrine problems.

Introduction About TORUTIC 10 TABLET

TORUTIC 10 TABLET contains torsemide, a diuretic medication used to reduce excess fluid retention in the body (edema) caused by heart, liver, or kidney conditions. It is also effective in managing high blood pressure.

It works by removing excess salts and fluids from the body (especially from the kidneys, lungs, heart, stomach) in the form of urine which helps reduce swelling caused by excess fluid buildup in conditions like heart failure, liver cirrhosis, or kidney disorders.

TORUTIC 10 TABLET is usually taken once a day with or without food. Try to take this medicine at the same time each day to help you remember. Take this medicine exactly as suggested by your doctor. Do not take more tablets in one day without consulting your doctor.

The active ingredient Torsemide present in the medicine controls high blood pressure and edema but does not cure these conditions. Therefore, continue to take this medicine even if you feel well. Do not stop taking TORUTIC 10 TABLET without talking to your doctor.

Common Side Effects of TORUTIC 10 TABLET are dizziness or lightheadedness, increased urination, low potassium levels, nausea or upset stomach or electrolyte imbalance. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

Before taking TORUTIC 10 TABLET, inform your doctor about all your pre-existing disease conditions and medicines you currently take. TORUTIC 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women.

mechanismOfAction:
How TORUTIC 10 TABLET Works

TORUTIC 10 TABLET contains an active ingredient called torsemide which is a diuretic agent (water pill). It works by eliminating excess salt and fluid accumulated in the body (due to kidney, liver and heart problems) via urine.

This helps relieve conditions like edema, high blood pressure, and fluid retention due to heart, liver, or kidney diseases. By removing extra fluid, TORUTIC 10 TABLET helps lower the pressure in the blood vessels and organs, improving overall health and comfort.
usageInstructions: Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water, preferably in the morning to avoid frequent urination at night.
It can be taken with or without food
The dosage of TORUTIC 10 TABLET depends on your medical condition, age, and response to the treatment.
For adults, the starting dose typically ranges from 5 to 10 mg daily. Your doctor may adjust the dose based on your progress.
Do not self-adjust the dose without consulting your healthcare provider. Regular monitoring of electrolyte levels and kidney function may be required during the treatment.
For managing edema (fluid retention), the usual dose of TORUTIC 10 TABLET is 10-20 mg once daily.
In severe cases, the dosage may be increased as per your doctor’s recommendation. Ensure adequate hydration and follow a low-sodium diet for best results.
In patients with kidney disease, the dosage of TORUTIC 10 TABLET varies based on the severity of the condition.
Typically, the doctor may start with a lower dose, such as 5-10 mg daily, to minimize the risk of side effects.
For advanced kidney conditions, higher doses may be prescribed under close medical supervision to prevent dehydration and electrolyte imbalances.
If you miss a dose of TORUTIC 10 TABLET, take it as soon as you remember.
However, if it’s almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule.

Do not take two doses at the same time to make up for the missed one, as it may increase the risk of side effects like dehydration or low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if you frequently miss doses.
The maximum dosage of TORUTIC 10 TABLET varies based on the condition being treated and the patient’s tolerance.
For most conditions, the dose should not exceed 20-40 mg daily, depending on the severity of fluid retention.

How to use TORUTIC 10 TABLET

Take TORUTIC 10 TABLET exactly as advised by your physician. Do not increase or decrease the dosage without consulting your physician.

How to Use TORUTIC 10 TABLET?

It can be taken with or without food
Dosage and Administration of TORUTIC 10 TABLET:
The dosage of TORUTIC 10 TABLET depends on your medical condition, age, and response to the treatment.
For adults, the starting dose typically ranges from 5 to 10 mg daily. Your doctor may adjust the dose based on your progress.
Do not self-adjust the dose without consulting your healthcare provider. Regular monitoring of electrolyte levels and kidney function may be required during the treatment.
TORUTIC 10 TABLET Dosage for Edema
For managing edema (fluid retention), the usual dose of TORUTIC 10 TABLET is 10-20 mg once daily.
In severe cases, the dosage may be increased as per your doctor’s recommendation. Ensure adequate hydration and follow a low-sodium diet for best results.
Dosage of TORUTIC 10 TABLET for Kidney Disease
In patients with kidney disease, the dosage of TORUTIC 10 TABLET varies based on the severity of the condition.
Typically, the doctor may start with a lower dose, such as 5-10 mg daily, to minimize the risk of side effects.
For advanced kidney conditions, higher doses may be prescribed under close medical supervision to prevent dehydration and electrolyte imbalances.
What Happens if I Miss a Dose of TORUTIC 10 TABLET?
If you miss a dose of TORUTIC 10 TABLET, take it as soon as you remember.
However, if it’s almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule.
Do not take two doses at the same time to make up for the missed one, as it may increase the risk of side effects like dehydration or low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if you frequently miss doses.
Can I Adjust the Dosage of TORUTIC 10 TABLET?

No, you should not adjust the dosage of TORUTIC 10 TABLET on your own. Changing the dose without consulting your doctor can lead to serious side effects, including dehydration, low potassium levels, or electrolyte imbalances. If you feel the current dose isn’t effective or causes unwanted effects, discuss it with your doctor for proper evaluation and adjustment.

What is the Maximum Dosage of TORUTIC 10 TABLET?
The maximum dosage of TORUTIC 10 TABLET varies based on the condition being treated and the patient’s tolerance.
For most conditions, the dose should not exceed 20-40 mg daily, depending on the severity of fluid retention.

Your doctor will determine the safe maximum dose for your specific situation. Taking doses higher than prescribed can lead to severe side effects and complications.

Side Effects Of TORUTIC 10 TABLET

Like all medicines, TORUTIC 10 TABLET may cause certain side effects in some individuals, although not everybody gets them

Common Side Effects of TORUTIC 10 TABLET are:
Dizziness or lightheadedness
Increased urination
Low potassium levels
Nausea or upset stomach
Electrolyte imbalance
Headache
Loss of appetite, Abdominal pain upper
Nausea, Vomiting
Diarrhoea, Constipation
Muscle spasms
Fatigue
TORUTIC 10 TABLET Side Effects on Kidneys:
Electrolyte Imbalances
Dehydration
Worsening of Kidney Function
Increased Creatinine Levels
When To Seek Medical Attention:

Stop taking TORUTIC 10 TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects

Signs of dehydration (such as excessive thirst, dryness of mouth with nausea, vomiting, feeling weak or tired, drowsiness, confusion, restlessness, muscle weakness)
Rapid, excessive weight loss
Vomiting blood
Chest pain
Allergic reaction causing skin rashes, itching, blisters and peeling of skin, difficulty breathing or swallowing
Worsening or pre-existing stomach pain

warnings.details: There are no well adequate studies regarding the use of torsemide in pregnant women. Animal studies have indicated a slight risk of birth defects. A risk to the growing fetus cannot be excluded. Therefore, TORUTIC 10 TABLET should not be used in pregnant women unless medically required. To manage your health condition during pregnancy, your doctor will suggest an alternative BP medications and heart medicines.

Safety and effectiveness of torsemide in breastfeeding women has not been established yet as it is not known if the medicine is excreted in the breastmilk. Therefore, TORUTIC 10 TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after taking TORUTIC 10 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORUTIC 10 TABLET as it might make you feel dizzy or drowsy.

TORUTIC 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in anuric patients (kidneys fail to produce urine). It should be taken with caution in patients with kidney failure, and severe urinary flow disorders. Regular check-ups for kidney function and electrolytes balance are crucial in such patient to avoid complications.

TORUTIC 10 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver diseases like cirrhosis and ascites. Proper dosage adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before use.
Do not take TORUTIC 10 TABLET if you are allergic to Torsemide or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
TORUTIC 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart failure. Therefore, inform your doctor all your pre-existing heart conditions as a precaution before taking TORUTIC 10 TABLET

TORUTIC 10 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children aged below 18 years due to lack of safety data. To get personalised advice, consult your doctor. Your child’s doctor may evaluate the risks and benefits of therapy before prescribing it to your child.

TORUTIC 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patient especially who have pre-existing heart, liver or kidney problems. Take all the blood tests and scans suggested by your doctor to ensure maximum safety.

Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

There are no well adequate studies regarding the use of torsemide in pregnant women. Animal studies have indicated a slight risk of birth defects. A risk to the growing fetus cannot be excluded. Therefore, TORUTIC 10 TABLET should not be used in pregnant women unless medically required. To manage your health condition during pregnancy, your doctor will suggest an alternative BP medications and heart medicines.

Breastfeeding
USE WITH CAUTION

Safety and effectiveness of torsemide in breastfeeding women has not been established yet as it is not known if the medicine is excreted in the breastmilk. Therefore, TORUTIC 10 TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

Driving and Using Machines
USE WITH CAUTION

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after taking TORUTIC 10 TABLET.

Alcohol
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TORUTIC 10 TABLET as it might make you feel dizzy or drowsy.

Kidney
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

TORUTIC 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in anuric patients (kidneys fail to produce urine). It should be taken with caution in patients with kidney failure, and severe urinary flow disorders. Regular check-ups for kidney function and electrolytes balance are crucial in such patient to avoid complications.

Liver
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

TORUTIC 10 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver diseases like cirrhosis and ascites. Proper dosage adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before use.

Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED

Do not take TORUTIC 10 TABLET if you are allergic to Torsemide or to any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

Heart Disease
USE WITH CAUTION

TORUTIC 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart failure. Therefore, inform your doctor all your pre-existing heart conditions as a precaution before taking TORUTIC 10 TABLET

Use In Pediatrics
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

TORUTIC 10 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children aged below 18 years due to lack of safety data. To get personalised advice, consult your doctor. Your child’s doctor may evaluate the risks and benefits of therapy before prescribing it to your child.

Use In Geriatrics
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

TORUTIC 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patient especially who have pre-existing heart, liver or kidney problems. Take all the blood tests and scans suggested by your doctor to ensure maximum safety.
